get_character_paragraph.desc: Returns the paragraph number of the character position provided. Paragraph and character numbers are both zero-indexed. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_content_height.desc: Returns the height of the content. Note: This method always returns the full content size, and is not affected by [member visible_ratio] and [member visible_characters]. To get the visible content size, use [method get_visible_content_rect]. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_content_width.desc: Returns the width of the content. Note: This method always returns the full content size, and is not affected by [member visible_ratio] and [member visible_characters]. To get the visible content size, use [method get_visible_content_rect]. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_line_count.desc: Returns the total number of lines in the text. Wrapped text is counted as multiple lines. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_line_height.desc: Returns the height of the line found at the provided index. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether the document is fully loaded.

get_line_offset.desc: Returns the vertical offset of the line found at the provided index. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_line_range.desc: Returns the indexes of the first and last visible characters for the given [param line], as a . Note: If [member visible_characters_behavior] is set to [constant TextServer.VC_CHARS_BEFORE_SHAPING] only visible wrapped lines are counted. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_line_width.desc: Returns the width of the line found at the provided index. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether the document is fully loaded.

get_menu.desc: Returns the of this . By default, this menu is displayed when right-clicking on the . You can add custom menu items or remove standard ones. Make sure your IDs don't conflict with the standard ones (see [enum MenuItems]). For example: func _ready(): var menu = get_menu() # Remove "Select All" item. menu.remove_item(MENU_SELECT_ALL) # Add custom items. menu.add_separator() menu.add_item("Duplicate Text", MENU_MAX + 1) # Connect callback. menu.id_pressed.connect(_on_item_pressed) func _on_item_pressed(id): if id == MENU_MAX + 1: add_text("\n" + get_parsed_text()) public override void _Ready() { var menu = GetMenu(); // Remove "Select All" item. menu.RemoveItem(RichTextLabel.MenuItems.SelectAll); // Add custom items. menu.AddSeparator(); menu.AddItem("Duplicate Text", RichTextLabel.MenuItems.Max + 1); // Add event handler. menu.IdPressed += OnItemPressed; } public void OnItemPressed(int id) { if (id == TextEdit.MenuItems.Max + 1) { AddText("\n" + GetParsedText()); } } Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their [member Window.visible] property.

get_paragraph_count.desc: Returns the total number of paragraphs (newlines or p tags in the tag stack's text tags). Considers wrapped text as one paragraph.

get_paragraph_offset.desc: Returns the vertical offset of the paragraph found at the provided index. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_parsed_text.desc: Returns the text without BBCode mark-up.

get_selected_text.desc: Returns the current selection text. Does not include BBCodes.

get_selection_from.desc: Returns the current selection first character index if a selection is active, -1 otherwise. Does not include BBCodes.

get_selection_line_offset.desc: Returns the current selection vertical line offset if a selection is active, -1.0 otherwise.

get_selection_to.desc: Returns the current selection last character index if a selection is active, -1 otherwise. Does not include BBCodes.

get_total_character_count.desc: Returns the total number of characters from text tags. Does not include BBCodes.

get_v_scroll_bar.desc: Returns the vertical scrollbar. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their [member CanvasItem.visible] property.

get_visible_content_rect.desc: Returns the bounding rectangle of the visible content. Note: This method returns a correct value only after the label has been drawn. extends RichTextLabel @export var background_panel: Panel func _ready(): await draw background_panel.position = get_visible_content_rect().position background_panel.size = get_visible_content_rect().size public partial class TestLabel : RichTextLabel { public Panel BackgroundPanel { get; set; } public override async void _Ready() { await ToSignal(this, Control.SignalName.Draw); BackgroundGPanel.Position = GetVisibleContentRect().Position; BackgroundPanel.Size = GetVisibleContentRect().Size; } }

get_visible_line_count.desc: Returns the number of visible lines. Note: This method returns a correct value only after the label has been drawn. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

get_visible_paragraph_count.desc: Returns the number of visible paragraphs. A paragraph is considered visible if at least one of its lines is visible. Note: This method returns a correct value only after the label has been drawn. Note: If [member threaded] is enabled, this method returns a value for the loaded part of the document. Use [method is_finished] or [signal finished] to determine whether document is fully loaded.

install_effect.desc: Installs a custom effect. This can also be done in the Inspector through the [member custom_effects] property. [param effect] should be a valid . Example: With the following script extending from : # effect.gd class_name MyCustomEffect extends RichTextEffect var bbcode = "my_custom_effect" # ... The above effect can be installed in from a script: # rich_text_label.gd extends RichTextLabel func _ready(): install_effect(MyCustomEffect.new()) # Alternatively, if not using `class_name` in the script that extends RichTextEffect: install_effect(preload("res://effect.gd").new())

invalidate_paragraph.desc: Invalidates [param paragraph] and all subsequent paragraphs cache.

is_finished.desc: If [member threaded] is enabled, returns true if the background thread has finished text processing, otherwise always return true.

is_menu_visible.desc: Returns whether the menu is visible. Use this instead of get_menu().visible to improve performance (so the creation of the menu is avoided).

is_ready.desc: If [member threaded] is enabled, returns true if the background thread has finished text processing, otherwise always return true.

menu_option.desc: Executes a given action as defined in the [enum MenuItems] enum.

newline.desc: Adds a newline tag to the tag stack.

parse_bbcode.desc: The assignment version of [method append_text]. Clears the tag stack and inserts the new content.

parse_expressions_for_values.desc: Parses BBCode parameter [param expressions] into a dictionary.

pop.desc: Terminates the current tag. Use after push_* methods to close BBCodes manually. Does not need to follow add_* methods.

pop_all.desc: Terminates all tags opened by push_* methods.

pop_context.desc: Terminates tags opened after the last [method push_context] call (including context marker), or all tags if there's no context marker on the stack.

push_bgcolor.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Note: The background color has padding applied by default, which is controlled using [theme_item text_highlight_h_padding] and [theme_item text_highlight_v_padding]. This can lead to overlapping highlights if background colors are placed on neighboring lines/columns, so consider setting those theme items to 0 if you want to avoid this.

push_bold.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag with a bold font to the tag stack. This is the same as adding a [code skip-lint] tag if not currently in a [code skip-lint] tag.

push_bold_italics.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag with a bold italics font to the tag stack.

push_cell.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Must be inside a [code skip-lint] tag. See [method push_table] for details. Use [method set_table_column_expand] to set column expansion ratio, [method set_cell_border_color] to set cell border, [method set_cell_row_background_color] to set cell background, [method set_cell_size_override] to override cell size, and [method set_cell_padding] to set padding.

push_color.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack.

push_context.desc: Adds a context marker to the tag stack. See [method pop_context].

push_customfx.desc: Adds a custom effect tag to the tag stack. The effect does not need to be in [member custom_effects]. The environment is directly passed to the effect.

push_dropcap.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Drop cap (dropped capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is larger than the rest of the text.

push_fgcolor.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Note: The foreground color has padding applied by default, which is controlled using [theme_item text_highlight_h_padding] and [theme_item text_highlight_v_padding]. This can lead to overlapping highlights if foreground colors are placed on neighboring lines/columns, so consider setting those theme items to 0 if you want to avoid this.

push_font.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Overrides default fonts for its duration. Passing 0 to [param font_size] will use the existing default font size.

push_font_size.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Overrides default font size for its duration.

push_hint.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Same as BBCode [code skip-lint]{text}.

push_indent.desc: Adds an [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Multiplies [param level] by current [member tab_size] to determine new margin length.

push_italics.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag with an italics font to the tag stack. This is the same as adding an [code skip-lint] tag if not currently in a [code skip-lint] tag.

push_language.desc: Adds language code used for text shaping algorithm and Open-Type font features.

push_list.desc: Adds [code skip-lint] or [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Multiplies [param level] by current [member tab_size] to determine new margin length.

push_meta.desc: Adds a meta tag to the tag stack. Similar to the BBCode [code skip-lint]{text}, but supports non- metadata types. If [member meta_underlined] is true, meta tags display an underline. This behavior can be customized with [param underline_mode]. Note: Meta tags do nothing by default when clicked. To assign behavior when clicked, connect [signal meta_clicked] to a function that is called when the meta tag is clicked.

push_mono.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag with a monospace font to the tag stack.

push_normal.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag with a normal font to the tag stack.

push_outline_color.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Adds text outline for its duration.

push_outline_size.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Overrides default text outline size for its duration.

push_paragraph.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack.

push_strikethrough.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. If [param color]'s alpha value is 0.0, the current font's color with its alpha multiplied by [theme_item strikethrough_alpha] is used.

push_table.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. Use [method set_table_column_expand] to set column expansion ratio. Use [method push_cell] to add cells. [param name] is used as the table name for assistive apps.

push_underline.desc: Adds a [code skip-lint] tag to the tag stack. If [param color]'s alpha value is 0.0, the current font's color with its alpha multiplied by [theme_item underline_alpha] is used.

reload_effects.desc: Reloads custom effects. Useful when [member custom_effects] is modified manually.

remove_paragraph.desc: Removes a paragraph of content from the label. Returns true if the paragraph exists. The [param paragraph] argument is the index of the paragraph to remove, it can take values in the interval [0, get_paragraph_count() - 1]. If [param no_invalidate] is set to true, cache for the subsequent paragraphs is not invalidated. Use it for faster updates if deleted paragraph is fully self-contained (have no unclosed tags), or this call is part of the complex edit operation and [method invalidate_paragraph] will be called at the end of operation.

scroll_to_line.desc: Scrolls the window's top line to match [param line].

scroll_to_paragraph.desc: Scrolls the window's top line to match first line of the [param paragraph].

scroll_to_selection.desc: Scrolls to the beginning of the current selection.

select_all.desc: Select all the text. If [member selection_enabled] is false, no selection will occur.

set_cell_border_color.desc: Sets color of a table cell border.

set_cell_padding.desc: Sets inner padding of a table cell.

set_cell_row_background_color.desc: Sets color of a table cell. Separate colors for alternating rows can be specified.

set_cell_size_override.desc: Sets minimum and maximum size overrides for a table cell.

set_table_column_expand.desc: Edits the selected column's expansion options. If [param expand] is true, the column expands in proportion to its expansion ratio versus the other columns' ratios. For example, 2 columns with ratios 3 and 4 plus 70 pixels in available width would expand 30 and 40 pixels, respectively. If [param expand] is false, the column will not contribute to the total ratio.

set_table_column_name.desc: Sets table column name for assistive apps.

update_image.desc: Updates the existing images with the key [param key]. Only properties specified by [param mask] bits are updated. See [method add_image].

RID.desc: A handle for a 's unique identifier.

get_id.desc: Returns the ID of the referenced low-level resource.

is_valid.desc: Returns true if the is not 0.

RigidBody2D.desc: A 2D physics body that is moved by a physics simulation.

_integrate_forces.desc: Called during physics processing, allowing you to read and safely modify the simulation state for the object. By default, it is called before the standard force integration, but the [member custom_integrator] property allows you to disable the standard force integration and do fully custom force integration for a body.

add_constant_central_force.desc: Adds a constant directional force without affecting rotation that keeps being applied over time until cleared with constant_force = Vector2(0, 0). This is equivalent to using [method add_constant_force] at the body's center of mass.

add_constant_force.desc: Adds a constant positioned force to the body that keeps being applied over time until cleared with constant_force = Vector2(0, 0). [param position] is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.

add_constant_torque.desc: Adds a constant rotational force without affecting position that keeps being applied over time until cleared with constant_torque = 0.

apply_central_force.desc: Applies a directional force without affecting rotation. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update. This is equivalent to using [method apply_force] at the body's center of mass.

apply_central_impulse.desc: Applies a directional impulse without affecting rotation. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise). This is equivalent to using [method apply_impulse] at the body's center of mass.

apply_force.desc: Applies a positioned force to the body. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update. [param position] is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.

apply_impulse.desc: Applies a positioned impulse to the body. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise). [param position] is the offset from the body origin in global coordinates.

apply_torque.desc: Applies a rotational force without affecting position. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update. Note: [member inertia] is required for this to work. To have [member inertia], an active must be a child of the node, or you can manually set [member inertia].

apply_torque_impulse.desc: Applies a rotational impulse to the body without affecting the position. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise). Note: [member inertia] is required for this to work. To have [member inertia], an active must be a child of the node, or you can manually set [member inertia].

get_colliding_bodies.desc: Returns a list of the bodies colliding with this one. Requires [member contact_monitor] to be set to true and [member max_contacts_reported] to be set high enough to detect all the collisions. Note: The result of this test is not immediate after moving objects. For performance, list of collisions is updated once per frame and before the physics step. Consider using signals instead.

get_contact_count.desc: Returns the number of contacts this body has with other bodies. By default, this returns 0 unless bodies are configured to monitor contacts (see [member contact_monitor]). Note: To retrieve the colliding bodies, use [method get_colliding_bodies].

set_axis_velocity.desc: Sets the body's velocity on the given axis. The velocity in the given vector axis will be set as the given vector length. This is useful for jumping behavior.

get_inverse_inertia_tensor.desc: Returns the inverse inertia tensor basis. This is used to calculate the angular acceleration resulting from a torque applied to the .

set_axis_velocity.desc: Sets an axis velocity. The velocity in the given vector axis will be set as the given vector length. This is useful for jumping behavior.

SceneState.desc: Provides access to a scene file's information.

get_base_scene_state.desc: Returns the of the scene that this scene inherits from, or null if it doesn't inherit from any scene.

get_connection_binds.desc: Returns the list of bound parameters for the signal at [param idx].

get_connection_count.desc: Returns the number of signal connections in the scene. The idx argument used to query connection metadata in other get_connection_* methods in the interval [0, get_connection_count() - 1].

get_connection_flags.desc: Returns the connection flags for the signal at [param idx]. See [enum Object.ConnectFlags] constants.

get_connection_method.desc: Returns the method connected to the signal at [param idx].

get_connection_signal.desc: Returns the name of the signal at [param idx].

get_connection_source.desc: Returns the path to the node that owns the signal at [param idx], relative to the root node.

get_connection_target.desc: Returns the path to the node that owns the method connected to the signal at [param idx], relative to the root node.

get_connection_unbinds.desc: Returns the number of unbound parameters for the signal at [param idx].

get_node_count.desc: Returns the number of nodes in the scene. The idx argument used to query node data in other get_node_* methods in the interval [0, get_node_count() - 1].

get_node_groups.desc: Returns the list of group names associated with the node at [param idx].

get_node_index.desc: Returns the node's index, which is its position relative to its siblings. This is only relevant and saved in scenes for cases where new nodes are added to an instantiated or inherited scene among siblings from the base scene. Despite the name, this index is not related to the [param idx] argument used here and in other methods.

get_node_instance.desc: Returns a for the node at [param idx] (i.e. the whole branch starting at this node, with its child nodes and resources), or null if the node is not an instance.

get_node_instance_placeholder.desc: Returns the path to the represented scene file if the node at [param idx] is an .

get_node_name.desc: Returns the name of the node at [param idx].

get_node_owner_path.desc: Returns the path to the owner of the node at [param idx], relative to the root node.

get_node_path.desc: Returns the path to the node at [param idx]. If [param for_parent] is true, returns the path of the [param idx] node's parent instead.

get_node_property_count.desc: Returns the number of exported or overridden properties for the node at [param idx]. The prop_idx argument used to query node property data in other get_node_property_* methods in the interval [0, get_node_property_count() - 1].

get_node_property_name.desc: Returns the name of the property at [param prop_idx] for the node at [param idx].

get_node_property_value.desc: Returns the value of the property at [param prop_idx] for the node at [param idx].

get_node_type.desc: Returns the type of the node at [param idx].

get_path.desc: Returns the resource path to the represented .

is_node_instance_placeholder.desc: Returns true if the node at [param idx] is an .

SceneTree.desc: Manages the game loop via a hierarchy of nodes.

call_group.desc: Calls [param method] on each node inside this tree added to the given [param group]. You can pass arguments to [param method] by specifying them at the end of this method call. Nodes that cannot call [param method] (either because the method doesn't exist or the arguments do not match) are ignored. See also [method set_group] and [method notify_group]. Note: This method acts immediately on all selected nodes at once, which may cause stuttering in some performance-intensive situations. Note: In C#, [param method] must be in snake_case when referring to built-in Godot methods. Prefer using the names exposed in the MethodName class to avoid allocating a new on each call.

call_group_flags.desc: Calls the given [param method] on each node inside this tree added to the given [param group]. Use [param flags] to customize this method's behavior (see [enum GroupCallFlags]). Additional arguments for [param method] can be passed at the end of this method. Nodes that cannot call [param method] (either because the method doesn't exist or the arguments do not match) are ignored. # Calls "hide" to all nodes of the "enemies" group, at the end of the frame and in reverse tree order. get_tree().call_group_flags( SceneTree.GROUP_CALL_DEFERRED | SceneTree.GROUP_CALL_REVERSE, "enemies", "hide") Note: In C#, [param method] must be in snake_case when referring to built-in Godot methods. Prefer using the names exposed in the MethodName class to avoid allocating a new on each call.

change_scene_to_file.desc: Changes the running scene to the one at the given [param path], after loading it into a and creating a new instance. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN] if the [param path] cannot be loaded into a , or [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] if that scene cannot be instantiated. Note: See [method change_scene_to_node] for details on the order of operations.

change_scene_to_node.desc: Changes the running scene to the provided . Useful when you want to set up the new scene before changing. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if the [param node] is null, or [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if the [param node] is already inside the scene tree. Note: Operations happen in the following order when [method change_scene_to_node] is called: 1. The current scene node is immediately removed from the tree. From that point, [method Node.get_tree] called on the current (outgoing) scene will return null. [member current_scene] will be null too, because the new scene is not available yet. 2. At the end of the frame, the formerly current scene, already removed from the tree, will be deleted (freed from memory) and then the new scene node will be added to the tree. [method Node.get_tree] and [member current_scene] will be back to working as usual. This ensures that both scenes aren't running at the same time, while still freeing the previous scene in a safe way similar to [method Node.queue_free]. If you want to reliably access the new scene, await the [signal scene_changed] signal. Warning: After using this method, the will take ownership of the node and will free it automatically when changing scene again. Any references you had to that node will become invalid.

change_scene_to_packed.desc: Changes the running scene to a new instance of the given (which must be valid). Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] if the scene cannot be instantiated, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if the scene is invalid. Note: See [method change_scene_to_node] for details on the order of operations.

create_timer.desc: Returns a new . After [param time_sec] in seconds have passed, the timer will emit [signal SceneTreeTimer.timeout] and will be automatically freed. If [param process_always] is false, the timer will be paused when setting [member SceneTree.paused] to true. If [param process_in_physics] is true, the timer will update at the end of the physics frame, instead of the process frame. If [param ignore_time_scale] is true, the timer will ignore [member Engine.time_scale] and update with the real, elapsed time. This method is commonly used to create a one-shot delay timer, as in the following example: func some_function(): print("start") await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout print("end") public async Task SomeFunction() { GD.Print("start"); await ToSignal(GetTree().CreateTimer(1.0f), SceneTreeTimer.SignalName.Timeout); GD.Print("end"); } Note: The timer is always updated after all of the nodes in the tree. A node's [method Node._process] method would be called before the timer updates (or [method Node._physics_process] if [param process_in_physics] is set to true).

create_tween.desc: Creates and returns a new processed in this tree. The Tween will start automatically on the next process frame or physics frame (depending on its [enum Tween.TweenProcessMode]). Note: A created using this method is not bound to any . It may keep working until there is nothing left to animate. If you want the to be automatically killed when the is freed, use [method Node.create_tween] or [method Tween.bind_node].

get_first_node_in_group.desc: Returns the first found inside the tree, that has been added to the given [param group], in scene hierarchy order. Returns null if no match is found. See also [method get_nodes_in_group].

get_frame.desc: Returns how many physics process steps have been processed, since the application started. This is not a measurement of elapsed time. See also [signal physics_frame]. For the number of frames rendered, see [method Engine.get_process_frames].

get_multiplayer.desc: Searches for the configured for the given path, if one does not exist it searches the parent paths until one is found. If the path is empty, or none is found, the default one is returned. See [method set_multiplayer].

get_node_count.desc: Returns the number of nodes inside this tree.

get_node_count_in_group.desc: Returns the number of nodes assigned to the given group.

get_nodes_in_group.desc: Returns an containing all nodes inside this tree, that have been added to the given [param group], in scene hierarchy order.

get_processed_tweens.desc: Returns an of currently existing s in the tree, including paused tweens.

has_group.desc: Returns true if a node added to the given group [param name] exists in the tree.

is_accessibility_enabled.desc: Returns true if accessibility features are enabled, and accessibility information updates are actively processed.

is_accessibility_supported.desc: Returns true if accessibility features are supported by the OS and enabled in project settings.

notify_group.desc: Calls [method Object.notification] with the given [param notification] to all nodes inside this tree added to the [param group]. See also Godot notifications and [method call_group] and [method set_group]. Note: This method acts immediately on all selected nodes at once, which may cause stuttering in some performance-intensive situations.

notify_group_flags.desc: Calls [method Object.notification] with the given [param notification] to all nodes inside this tree added to the [param group]. Use [param call_flags] to customize this method's behavior (see [enum GroupCallFlags]).

queue_delete.desc: Queues the given [param obj] to be deleted, calling its [method Object.free] at the end of the current frame. This method is similar to [method Node.queue_free].

quit.desc: Quits the application at the end of the current iteration, with the given [param exit_code]. By convention, an exit code of 0 indicates success, whereas any other exit code indicates an error. For portability reasons, it should be between 0 and 125 (inclusive). Note: On iOS this method doesn't work. Instead, as recommended by the iOS Human Interface Guidelines, the user is expected to close apps via the Home button.

reload_current_scene.desc: Reloads the currently active scene, replacing [member current_scene] with a new instance of its original . Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if no [member current_scene] is defined, [constant ERR_CANT_OPEN] if [member current_scene] cannot be loaded into a , or [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] if the scene cannot be instantiated.

set_group.desc: Sets the given [param property] to [param value] on all nodes inside this tree added to the given [param group]. Nodes that do not have the [param property] are ignored. See also [method call_group] and [method notify_group]. Note: This method acts immediately on all selected nodes at once, which may cause stuttering in some performance-intensive situations. Note: In C#, [param property] must be in snake_case when referring to built-in Godot properties. Prefer using the names exposed in the PropertyName class to avoid allocating a new on each call.

set_group_flags.desc: Sets the given [param property] to [param value] on all nodes inside this tree added to the given [param group]. Nodes that do not have the [param property] are ignored. Use [param call_flags] to customize this method's behavior (see [enum GroupCallFlags]). Note: In C#, [param property] must be in snake_case when referring to built-in Godot properties. Prefer using the names exposed in the PropertyName class to avoid allocating a new on each call.

set_multiplayer.desc: Sets a custom with the given [param root_path] (controlling also the relative subpaths), or override the default one if [param root_path] is empty. Note: No must be configured for the subpath containing [param root_path], nested custom multiplayers are not allowed. I.e. if one is configured for "/root/Foo" setting one for "/root/Foo/Bar" will cause an error. Note: [method set_multiplayer] should be called before the child nodes are ready at the given [param root_path]. If multiplayer nodes like or are added to the tree before the custom multiplayer API is set, they will not work.

unload_current_scene.desc: If a current scene is loaded, calling this method will unload it.

Otherwise, the returned list contains contact points arranged in pairs, with entries alternating between points on the boundary of this shape and points on the boundary of [param with_shape]. A collision pair A, B can be used to calculate the collision normal with (B - A).normalized(), and the collision depth with (B - A).length(). This information is typically used to separate shapes, particularly in collision solvers. This method needs the transformation matrix for this shape ([param local_xform]), the shape to check collisions with ([param with_shape]), and the transformation matrix of that shape ([param shape_xform]).

set_modification_stack.desc: Sets the attached to this skeleton.

Skeleton3D.desc: A node containing a bone hierarchy, used to create a 3D skeletal animation.

add_bone.desc: Adds a new bone with the given name. Returns the new bone's index, or -1 if this method fails. Note: Bone names should be unique, non empty, and cannot include the : and / characters.

advance.desc: Manually advance the child s by the specified time (in seconds). Note: The [param delta] is temporarily accumulated in the , and the deferred process uses the accumulated value to process the modification.

clear_bones.desc: Clear all the bones in this skeleton.

clear_bones_global_pose_override.desc: Removes the global pose override on all bones in the skeleton.

find_bone.desc: Returns the bone index that matches [param name] as its name. Returns -1 if no bone with this name exists.

force_update_all_bone_transforms.desc: Force updates the bone transforms/poses for all bones in the skeleton.

force_update_bone_child_transform.desc: Force updates the bone transform for the bone at [param bone_idx] and all of its children.

get_bone_children.desc: Returns an array containing the bone indexes of all the child node of the passed in bone, [param bone_idx].

get_bone_count.desc: Returns the number of bones in the skeleton.

get_bone_global_pose.desc: Returns the overall transform of the specified bone, with respect to the skeleton. Being relative to the skeleton frame, this is not the actual "global" transform of the bone. Note: This is the global pose you set to the skeleton in the process, the final global pose can get overridden by modifiers in the deferred process, if you want to access the final global pose, use [signal SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed].

get_bone_global_pose_no_override.desc: Returns the overall transform of the specified bone, with respect to the skeleton, but without any global pose overrides. Being relative to the skeleton frame, this is not the actual "global" transform of the bone.

get_bone_global_pose_override.desc: Returns the global pose override transform for [param bone_idx].

get_bone_global_rest.desc: Returns the global rest transform for [param bone_idx].

get_bone_meta.desc: Returns the metadata with the given [param key] for the bone at index [param bone_idx].

get_bone_meta_list.desc: Returns the list of all metadata keys for the bone at index [param bone_idx].

get_bone_name.desc: Returns the name of the bone at index [param bone_idx].

get_bone_parent.desc: Returns the bone index which is the parent of the bone at [param bone_idx]. If -1, then bone has no parent. Note: The parent bone returned will always be less than [param bone_idx].

get_bone_pose.desc: Returns the pose transform of the specified bone. Note: This is the pose you set to the skeleton in the process, the final pose can get overridden by modifiers in the deferred process, if you want to access the final pose, use [signal SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed].

get_bone_pose_position.desc: Returns the pose position of the bone at [param bone_idx]. The returned is in the local coordinate space of the node.

get_bone_pose_rotation.desc: Returns the pose rotation of the bone at [param bone_idx]. The returned is local to the bone with respect to the rotation of any parent bones.

get_bone_pose_scale.desc: Returns the pose scale of the bone at [param bone_idx].

get_bone_rest.desc: Returns the rest transform for a bone [param bone_idx].

get_concatenated_bone_names.desc: Returns all bone names concatenated with commas (,) as a single . It is useful to set it as a hint for the enum property.

get_parentless_bones.desc: Returns an array with all of the bones that are parentless. Another way to look at this is that it returns the indexes of all the bones that are not dependent or modified by other bones in the Skeleton.

get_version.desc: Returns the number of times the bone hierarchy has changed within this skeleton, including renames. The Skeleton version is not serialized: only use within a single instance of Skeleton3D. Use for invalidating caches in IK solvers and other nodes which process bones.

has_bone_meta.desc: Returns true if the bone at index [param bone_idx] has metadata with the given [param key].

is_bone_enabled.desc: Returns whether the bone pose for the bone at [param bone_idx] is enabled.

localize_rests.desc: Returns all bones in the skeleton to their rest poses.

physical_bones_add_collision_exception.desc: Adds a collision exception to the physical bone. Works just like the node.

physical_bones_remove_collision_exceptio.desc: Removes a collision exception to the physical bone. Works just like the node.

physical_bones_start_simulation.desc: Tells the nodes in the Skeleton to start simulating and reacting to the physics world. Optionally, a list of bone names can be passed-in, allowing only the passed-in bones to be simulated.

physical_bones_stop_simulation.desc: Tells the nodes in the Skeleton to stop simulating.

register_skin.desc: Binds the given Skin to the Skeleton.

reset_bone_pose.desc: Sets the bone pose to rest for [param bone_idx].

reset_bone_poses.desc: Sets all bone poses to rests.

set_bone_enabled.desc: Disables the pose for the bone at [param bone_idx] if false, enables the bone pose if true.

set_bone_global_pose.desc: Sets the global pose transform, [param pose], for the bone at [param bone_idx]. Note: If other bone poses have been changed, this method executes a dirty poses recalculation and will cause performance to deteriorate. If you know that multiple global poses will be applied, consider using [method set_bone_pose] with precalculation.

set_bone_global_pose_override.desc: Sets the global pose transform, [param pose], for the bone at [param bone_idx]. [param amount] is the interpolation strength that will be used when applying the pose, and [param persistent] determines if the applied pose will remain. Note: The pose transform needs to be a global pose! To convert a world transform from a to a global bone pose, multiply the [method Transform3D.affine_inverse] of the node's [member Node3D.global_transform] by the desired world transform.

set_bone_meta.desc: Sets the metadata with the given [param key] to [param value] for the bone at index [param bone_idx].

set_bone_name.desc: Sets the bone name, [param name], for the bone at [param bone_idx].

set_bone_parent.desc: Sets the bone index [param parent_idx] as the parent of the bone at [param bone_idx]. If -1, then bone has no parent. Note: [param parent_idx] must be less than [param bone_idx].

set_bone_pose.desc: Sets the pose transform, [param pose], for the bone at [param bone_idx].

set_bone_pose_position.desc: Sets the pose position of the bone at [param bone_idx] to [param position]. [param position] is a describing a position local to the node.

set_bone_pose_rotation.desc: Sets the pose rotation of the bone at [param bone_idx] to [param rotation]. [param rotation] is a describing a rotation in the bone's local coordinate space with respect to the rotation of any parent bones.

set_bone_pose_scale.desc: Sets the pose scale of the bone at [param bone_idx] to [param scale].

set_bone_rest.desc: Sets the rest transform for bone [param bone_idx].

unparent_bone_and_rest.desc: Unparents the bone at [param bone_idx] and sets its rest position to that of its parent prior to being reset.

SkeletonIK3D.desc: A node used to rotate all bones of a bone chain a way that places the end bone at a desired 3D position.

get_parent_skeleton.desc: Returns the parent node that was present when SkeletonIK entered the scene tree. Returns null if the parent node was not a node when SkeletonIK3D entered the scene tree.

is_running.desc: Returns true if SkeletonIK is applying IK effects on continues frames to the bones. Returns false if SkeletonIK is stopped or [method start] was used with the one_time parameter set to true.

start.desc: Starts applying IK effects on each frame to the bones but will only take effect starting on the next frame. If [param one_time] is true, this will take effect immediately but also reset on the next frame.

stop.desc: Stops applying IK effects on each frame to the bones and also calls [method Skeleton3D.clear_bones_global_pose_override] to remove existing overrides on all bones.

SkeletonModification2D.desc: Base class for resources that operate on s in a .

_draw_editor_gizmo.desc: Used for drawing editor-only modification gizmos. This function will only be called in the Godot editor and can be overridden to draw custom gizmos. Note: You will need to use the Skeleton2D from [method SkeletonModificationStack2D.get_skeleton] and it's draw functions, as the resource cannot draw on its own.

_execute.desc: Executes the given modification. This is where the modification performs whatever function it is designed to do.

_setup_modification.desc: Called when the modification is setup. This is where the modification performs initialization.

clamp_angle.desc: Takes an angle and clamps it so it is within the passed-in [param min] and [param max] range. [param invert] will inversely clamp the angle, clamping it to the range outside of the given bounds.

get_editor_draw_gizmo.desc: Returns whether this modification will call [method _draw_editor_gizmo] in the Godot editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.

get_is_setup.desc: Returns whether this modification has been successfully setup or not.

get_modification_stack.desc: Returns the that this modification is bound to. Through the modification stack, you can access the Skeleton2D the modification is operating on.

set_editor_draw_gizmo.desc: Sets whether this modification will call [method _draw_editor_gizmo] in the Godot editor to draw modification-specific gizmos.

set_is_setup.desc: Manually allows you to set the setup state of the modification. This function should only rarely be used, as the the modification is bound to should handle setting the modification up.

SkeletonModification2DCCDIK.desc: A modification that uses CCDIK to manipulate a series of bones to reach a target in 2D.

get_ccdik_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Returns the node assigned to the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx].

get_ccdik_joint_bone_index.desc: Returns the index of the node assigned to the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx].

get_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_invert.desc: Returns whether the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx] uses an inverted joint constraint. See [method set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_invert] for details.

get_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_max.desc: Returns the maximum angle constraint for the joint at [param joint_idx].

get_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_min.desc: Returns the minimum angle constraint for the joint at [param joint_idx].

get_ccdik_joint_enable_constraint.desc: Returns whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx] are enabled.

get_ccdik_joint_rotate_from_joint.desc: Returns whether the joint at [param joint_idx] is set to rotate from the joint, true, or to rotate from the tip, false. The default is to rotate from the tip.

set_ccdik_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Sets the node assigned to the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx].

set_ccdik_joint_bone_index.desc: Sets the bone index, [param bone_idx], of the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx]. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the CCDIK joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.

set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_invert.desc: Sets whether the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx] uses an inverted joint constraint. An inverted joint constraint only constraints the CCDIK joint to the angles outside of the inputted minimum and maximum angles. For this reason, it is referred to as an inverted joint constraint, as it constraints the joint to the outside of the inputted values.

set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_max.desc: Sets the maximum angle constraint for the joint at [param joint_idx].

set_ccdik_joint_constraint_angle_min.desc: Sets the minimum angle constraint for the joint at [param joint_idx].

set_ccdik_joint_enable_constraint.desc: Determines whether angle constraints on the CCDIK joint at [param joint_idx] are enabled. When true, constraints will be enabled and taken into account when solving.

set_ccdik_joint_rotate_from_joint.desc: Sets whether the joint at [param joint_idx] is set to rotate from the joint, true, or to rotate from the tip, false.

SkeletonModification2DFABRIK.desc: A modification that uses FABRIK to manipulate a series of nodes to reach a target.

get_fabrik_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Returns the node assigned to the FABRIK joint at [param joint_idx].

get_fabrik_joint_bone_index.desc: Returns the index of the node assigned to the FABRIK joint at [param joint_idx].

get_fabrik_joint_magnet_position.desc: Returns the magnet position vector for the joint at [param joint_idx].

get_fabrik_joint_use_target_rotation.desc: Returns whether the joint is using the target's rotation rather than allowing FABRIK to rotate the joint. This option only applies to the tip/final joint in the chain.

set_fabrik_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Sets the node assigned to the FABRIK joint at [param joint_idx].

set_fabrik_joint_bone_index.desc: Sets the bone index, [param bone_idx], of the FABRIK joint at [param joint_idx]. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the FABRIK joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.

set_fabrik_joint_magnet_position.desc: Sets the magnet position vector for the joint at [param joint_idx].

set_fabrik_joint_use_target_rotation.desc: Sets whether the joint at [param joint_idx] will use the target node's rotation rather than letting FABRIK rotate the node. Note: This option only works for the tip/final joint in the chain. For all other nodes, this option will be ignored.

SkeletonModification2DJiggle.desc: A modification that jiggles nodes as they move towards a target.

get_collision_mask.desc: Returns the collision mask used by the Jiggle modifier when collisions are enabled.

get_jiggle_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Returns the node assigned to the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

get_jiggle_joint_bone_index.desc: Returns the index of the node assigned to the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

get_jiggle_joint_damping.desc: Returns the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

get_jiggle_joint_gravity.desc: Returns a representing the amount of gravity the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx] is influenced by.

get_jiggle_joint_mass.desc: Returns the amount of mass of the jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

get_jiggle_joint_override.desc: Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at [param joint_idx] is overriding the default Jiggle joint data defined in the modification.

get_jiggle_joint_stiffness.desc: Returns the stiffness of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

get_jiggle_joint_use_gravity.desc: Returns a boolean that indicates whether the joint at [param joint_idx] is using gravity or not.

get_use_colliders.desc: Returns whether the jiggle modifier is taking physics colliders into account when solving.

set_collision_mask.desc: Sets the collision mask that the Jiggle modifier will use when reacting to colliders, if the Jiggle modifier is set to take colliders into account.

set_jiggle_joint_bone2d_node.desc: Sets the node assigned to the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

set_jiggle_joint_bone_index.desc: Sets the bone index, [param bone_idx], of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx]. When possible, this will also update the bone2d_node of the Jiggle joint based on data provided by the linked skeleton.

set_jiggle_joint_damping.desc: Sets the amount of damping of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

set_jiggle_joint_gravity.desc: Sets the gravity vector of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

set_jiggle_joint_mass.desc: Sets the of mass of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

set_jiggle_joint_override.desc: Sets whether the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx] should override the default Jiggle joint settings. Setting this to true will make the joint use its own settings rather than the default ones attached to the modification.

set_jiggle_joint_stiffness.desc: Sets the of stiffness of the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx].

set_jiggle_joint_use_gravity.desc: Sets whether the Jiggle joint at [param joint_idx] should use gravity.

set_use_colliders.desc: If true, the Jiggle modifier will take colliders into account, keeping them from entering into these collision objects.

SkeletonModification2DLookAt.desc: A modification that rotates a node to look at a target.

get_additional_rotation.desc: Returns the amount of additional rotation that is applied after the LookAt modification executes.

get_constraint_angle_invert.desc: Returns whether the constraints to this modification are inverted or not.

get_constraint_angle_max.desc: Returns the constraint's maximum allowed angle.

get_constraint_angle_min.desc: Returns the constraint's minimum allowed angle.

get_enable_constraint.desc: Returns true if the LookAt modification is using constraints.

set_additional_rotation.desc: Sets the amount of additional rotation that is to be applied after executing the modification. This allows for offsetting the results by the inputted rotation amount.

set_constraint_angle_invert.desc: When true, the modification will use an inverted joint constraint. An inverted joint constraint only constraints the to the angles outside of the inputted minimum and maximum angles. For this reason, it is referred to as an inverted joint constraint, as it constraints the joint to the outside of the inputted values.

set_constraint_angle_max.desc: Sets the constraint's maximum allowed angle.

set_constraint_angle_min.desc: Sets the constraint's minimum allowed angle.

set_enable_constraint.desc: Sets whether this modification will use constraints or not. When true, constraints will be applied when solving the LookAt modification.

SkeletonModification2DPhysicalBones.desc: A modification that applies the transforms of nodes to nodes.

fetch_physical_bones.desc: Empties the list of nodes and populates it with all nodes that are children of the .

set_physical_bone_node.desc: Sets the node at [param joint_idx]. Note: This is just the index used for this modification, not the bone index used in the .

start_simulation.desc: Tell the nodes to start simulating and interacting with the physics world. Optionally, an array of bone names can be passed to this function, and that will cause only nodes with those names to start simulating.

stop_simulation.desc: Tell the nodes to stop simulating and interacting with the physics world. Optionally, an array of bone names can be passed to this function, and that will cause only nodes with those names to stop simulating.

SkeletonModification2DStackHolder.desc: A modification that holds and executes a .

get_held_modification_stack.desc: Returns the that this modification is holding.

set_held_modification_stack.desc: Sets the that this modification is holding. This modification stack will then be executed when this modification is executed.

SkeletonModification2DTwoBoneIK.desc: A modification that rotates two bones using the law of cosines to reach the target.

get_joint_one_bone2d_node.desc: Returns the node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

get_joint_one_bone_idx.desc: Returns the index of the node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

get_joint_two_bone2d_node.desc: Returns the node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

get_joint_two_bone_idx.desc: Returns the index of the node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

set_joint_one_bone2d_node.desc: Sets the node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

set_joint_one_bone_idx.desc: Sets the index of the node that is being used as the first bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

set_joint_two_bone2d_node.desc: Sets the node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

set_joint_two_bone_idx.desc: Sets the index of the node that is being used as the second bone in the TwoBoneIK modification.

SkeletonModificationStack2D.desc: A resource that holds a stack of s.

add_modification.desc: Adds the passed-in to the stack.

delete_modification.desc: Deletes the at the index position [param mod_idx], if it exists.

enable_all_modifications.desc: Enables all s in the stack.

execute.desc: Executes all of the s in the stack that use the same execution mode as the passed-in [param execution_mode], starting from index 0 to [member modification_count]. Note: The order of the modifications can matter depending on the modifications. For example, modifications on a spine should operate before modifications on the arms in order to get proper results.

get_is_setup.desc: Returns a boolean that indicates whether the modification stack is setup and can execute.

get_modification.desc: Returns the at the passed-in index, [param mod_idx].

get_skeleton.desc: Returns the node that the SkeletonModificationStack2D is bound to.

set_modification.desc: Sets the modification at [param mod_idx] to the passed-in modification, [param modification].

setup.desc: Sets up the modification stack so it can execute. This function should be called by and shouldn't be manually called unless you know what you are doing.

SkeletonModifier3D.desc: A node that may modify a Skeleton3D's bones.

_process_modification.desc: Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier. You should do things like get the 's current pose and apply the pose here. [method _process_modification] must not apply [member influence] to bone poses because the automatically applies influence to all bone poses set by the modifier.

_process_modification_with_delta.desc: Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier. You should do things like get the 's current pose and apply the pose here. [method _process_modification_with_delta] must not apply [member influence] to bone poses because the automatically applies influence to all bone poses set by the modifier. [param delta] is passed from parent . See also [method Skeleton3D.advance]. Note: This method may be called outside [method Node._process] and [method Node._physics_process] with [param delta] is 0.0, since the modification should be processed immediately after initialization of the .

_skeleton_changed.desc: Called when the skeleton is changed.

_validate_bone_names.desc: Called when bone names and indices need to be validated, such as when entering the scene tree or changing skeleton.

get_skeleton.desc: Returns the parent node if it exists. Otherwise, returns null.

SkeletonProfile.desc: Base class for a profile of a virtual skeleton used as a target for retargeting.

find_bone.desc: Returns the bone index that matches [param bone_name] as its name.

get_bone_name.desc: Returns the name of the bone at [param bone_idx] that will be the key name in the . In the retargeting process, the returned bone name is the bone name of the target skeleton.

get_bone_parent.desc: Returns the name of the bone which is the parent to the bone at [param bone_idx]. The result is empty if the bone has no parent.

get_bone_tail.desc: Returns the name of the bone which is the tail of the bone at [param bone_idx].

get_group.desc: Returns the group of the bone at [param bone_idx].

get_group_name.desc: Returns the name of the group at [param group_idx] that will be the drawing group in the editor.

get_handle_offset.desc: Returns the offset of the bone at [param bone_idx] that will be the button position in the editor. This is the offset with origin at the top left corner of the square.

get_reference_pose.desc: Returns the reference pose transform for bone [param bone_idx].

get_tail_direction.desc: Returns the tail direction of the bone at [param bone_idx].

get_texture.desc: Returns the texture of the group at [param group_idx] that will be the drawing group background image in the editor.

is_required.desc: Returns whether the bone at [param bone_idx] is required for retargeting. This value is used by the bone map editor. If this method returns true, and no bone is assigned, the handle color will be red on the bone map editor.

set_bone_name.desc: Sets the name of the bone at [param bone_idx] that will be the key name in the . In the retargeting process, the setting bone name is the bone name of the target skeleton.

set_bone_parent.desc: Sets the bone with name [param bone_parent] as the parent of the bone at [param bone_idx]. If an empty string is passed, then the bone has no parent.

set_bone_tail.desc: Sets the bone with name [param bone_tail] as the tail of the bone at [param bone_idx].

set_group.desc: Sets the group of the bone at [param bone_idx].

set_group_name.desc: Sets the name of the group at [param group_idx] that will be the drawing group in the editor.

set_handle_offset.desc: Sets the offset of the bone at [param bone_idx] that will be the button position in the editor. This is the offset with origin at the top left corner of the square.

set_reference_pose.desc: Sets the reference pose transform for bone [param bone_idx].

set_required.desc: Sets the required status for bone [param bone_idx] to [param required].

set_tail_direction.desc: Sets the tail direction of the bone at [param bone_idx]. Note: This only specifies the method of calculation. The actual coordinates required should be stored in an external skeleton, so the calculation itself needs to be done externally.

set_texture.desc: Sets the texture of the group at [param group_idx] that will be the drawing group background image in the editor.

SkinReference.desc: A reference-counted holder object for a skeleton RID used in the .

get_skeleton.desc: Returns the owned by this SkinReference, as returned by [method RenderingServer.skeleton_create].

get_skin.desc: Returns the connected to this SkinReference. In the case of with no [member MeshInstance3D.skin] assigned, this will reference an internal default owned by that . Note that a single may have more than one in the case that it is shared by meshes across multiple nodes.

Sky.desc: Defines a 3D environment's background by using a .

SliderJoint3D.desc: A physics joint that restricts the movement of a 3D physics body along an axis relative to another physics body.

get_param.desc: Returns the value of the given parameter.

set_param.desc: Assigns [param value] to the given parameter.

SocketServer.desc: An abstract class for servers based on sockets.

is_connection_available.desc: Returns true if a connection is available for taking.

is_listening.desc: Returns true if the server is currently listening for connections.

take_socket_connection.desc: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerSocket with the connection.

add_collision_exception_with.desc: Adds a body to the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.

apply_central_force.desc: Distributes and applies a force to all points. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

apply_central_impulse.desc: Distributes and applies an impulse to all points. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise).

apply_force.desc: Applies a force to a point. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

apply_impulse.desc: Applies an impulse to a point. An impulse is time-independent! Applying an impulse every frame would result in a framerate-dependent force. For this reason, it should only be used when simulating one-time impacts (use the "_force" functions otherwise).

get_collision_exceptions.desc: Returns an array of nodes that were added as collision exceptions for this body.

get_collision_layer_value.desc: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_layer] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

get_collision_mask_value.desc: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_mask] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

get_physics_rid.desc: Returns the internal used by the for this body.

get_point_transform.desc: Returns local translation of a vertex in the surface array.

is_point_pinned.desc: Returns true if vertex is set to pinned.

remove_collision_exception_with.desc: Removes a body from the list of bodies that this body can't collide with.

set_collision_layer_value.desc: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_layer], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

set_collision_mask_value.desc: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_mask], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

set_point_pinned.desc: Sets the pinned state of a surface vertex. When set to true, the optional [param attachment_path] can define a the pinned vertex will be attached to.

SphereOccluder3D.desc: Spherical shape for use with occlusion culling in .

SphereShape3D.desc: A 3D sphere shape used for physics collision.

apply.desc: Applies the current value of this . This is equivalent to pressing Enter while editing the used by the . This will cause [signal LineEdit.text_submitted] to be emitted and its currently contained expression to be evaluated.

get_line_edit.desc: Returns the instance from this . You can use it to access properties and methods of . Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their [member CanvasItem.visible] property.

SplineIK3D.desc: A for aligning bones along a .

get_path_3d.desc: Returns the node path of the which is describing the path.

get_tilt_fade_in.desc: Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the root bone and the start point of the when they are apart. See also [method set_tilt_fade_in].

get_tilt_fade_out.desc: Returns the tilt interpolation method used between the end bone and the end point of the when they are apart. See also [method set_tilt_fade_out].

is_tilt_enabled.desc: Returns if the tilt property of the affects the bone twist.

set_path_3d.desc: Sets the node path of the which is describing the path.

set_tilt_enabled.desc: Sets if the tilt property of the should affect the bone twist.

set_tilt_fade_in.desc: If [param size] is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between [param size] start bones from the start point of the when they are apart. If [param size] is equal 0, the tilts between the root bone head and the start point of the are unified with a tilt of the start point of the . If [param size] is less than 0, the tilts between the root bone and the start point of the are 0.0.

set_tilt_fade_out.desc: If [param size] is greater than 0, the tilt is interpolated between [param size] end bones from the end point of the when they are apart. If [param size] is equal 0, the tilts between the end bone tail and the end point of the are unified with a tilt of the end point of the . If [param size] is less than 0, the tilts between the end bone and the end point of the are 0.0.

SplitContainer.desc: A container that arranges child controls horizontally or vertically and provides grabbers for adjusting the split ratios between them.

clamp_split_offset.desc: Clamps the [member split_offsets] values to ensure they are within valid ranges and do not overlap with each other. When overlaps occur, this method prioritizes one split offset (at index [param priority_index]) by clamping any overlapping split offsets to it.

get_drag_area_control.desc: Returns the drag area . For example, you can move a pre-configured button into the drag area so that it rides along with the split bar. Try setting the anchors to center prior to the reparent() call. $BarnacleButton.reparent($SplitContainer.get_drag_area_control()) Note: The drag area is drawn over the 's children, so draw objects called from the and children added to the will also appear over the 's children. Try setting [member Control.mouse_filter] of custom children to [constant Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE] to prevent blocking the mouse from dragging if desired. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash.

get_drag_area_controls.desc: Returns an of the drag area s. These are the interactable nodes between each child. For example, this can be used to add a pre-configured button to a drag area so that it rides along with the split bar. Try setting the anchors to center prior to the [method Node.reparent] call. $BarnacleButton.reparent($SplitContainer.get_drag_area_controls()) Note: The drag area s are drawn over the 's children, so draw objects called from a drag area and children added to it will also appear over the 's children. Try setting [member Control.mouse_filter] of custom children to [constant Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE] to prevent blocking the mouse from dragging if desired. Warning: These are required internal nodes, removing or freeing them may cause a crash.

SpotLight3D.desc: A spotlight, such as a reflector spotlight or a lantern.

SpringArm3D.desc: A 3D raycast that dynamically moves its children near the collision point.

add_excluded_object.desc: Adds the object with the given to the list of objects excluded from the collision check.

clear_excluded_objects.desc: Clears the list of objects excluded from the collision check.

get_hit_length.desc: Returns the spring arm's current length.

remove_excluded_object.desc: Removes the given from the list of objects excluded from the collision check.

SpringBoneCollision3D.desc: A base class of the collision that interacts with .

get_skeleton.desc: Get parent node of the parent if found.

SpringBoneCollisionCapsule3D.desc: A capsule shape collision that interacts with .

SpringBoneCollisionPlane3D.desc: An infinite plane collision that interacts with .

SpringBoneCollisionSphere3D.desc: A sphere shape collision that interacts with .

SpringBoneSimulator3D.desc: A to apply inertial wavering to bone chains.

are_all_child_collisions_enabled.desc: Returns true if all child s are contained in the collision list at [param index] in the settings.

clear_collisions.desc: Clears all collisions from the collision list at [param index] in the settings when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is false.

clear_exclude_collisions.desc: Clears all exclude collisions from the collision list at [param index] in the settings when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is true.

get_center_bone.desc: Returns the center bone index of the bone chain.

get_center_bone_name.desc: Returns the center bone name of the bone chain.

get_center_from.desc: Returns what the center originates from in the bone chain.

get_center_node.desc: Returns the center node path of the bone chain.

get_collision_count.desc: Returns the collision count of the bone chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is false.

get_collision_path.desc: Returns the node path of the at [param collision] in the bone chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is false.

get_drag.desc: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.

get_drag_damping_curve.desc: Returns the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.

get_end_bone.desc: Returns the end bone index of the bone chain.

get_end_bone_direction.desc: Returns the tail direction of the end bone of the bone chain when [method is_end_bone_extended] is true.

get_end_bone_length.desc: Returns the end bone tail length of the bone chain when [method is_end_bone_extended] is true.

get_end_bone_name.desc: Returns the end bone name of the bone chain.

get_exclude_collision_count.desc: Returns the exclude collision count of the bone chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is true.

get_exclude_collision_path.desc: Returns the node path of the at [param collision] in the bone chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is true.

get_gravity.desc: Returns the gravity amount of the bone chain.

get_gravity_damping_curve.desc: Returns the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.

get_gravity_direction.desc: Returns the gravity direction of the bone chain.

get_joint_bone.desc: Returns the bone index at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_bone_name.desc: Returns the bone name at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_count.desc: Returns the joint count of the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_drag.desc: Returns the drag force at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_gravity.desc: Returns the gravity amount at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_gravity_direction.desc: Returns the gravity direction at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_radius.desc: Returns the radius at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_rotation_axis.desc: Returns the rotation axis at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_joint_rotation_axis_vector.desc: Returns the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone chain. This vector represents the axis around which the joint can rotate. It is determined based on the rotation axis set for the joint. If [method get_joint_rotation_axis] is [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL], this method returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).

get_joint_stiffness.desc: Returns the stiffness force at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list.

get_radius.desc: Returns the joint radius of the bone chain.

get_radius_damping_curve.desc: Returns the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.

get_root_bone.desc: Returns the root bone index of the bone chain.

get_root_bone_name.desc: Returns the root bone name of the bone chain.

get_rotation_axis.desc: Returns the rotation axis of the bone chain.

get_rotation_axis_vector.desc: Returns the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. This vector represents the axis around which the bone chain can rotate. It is determined based on the rotation axis set for the bone chain. If [method get_rotation_axis] is [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL], this method returns Vector3(0, 0, 0).

get_stiffness.desc: Returns the stiffness force of the bone chain.

get_stiffness_damping_curve.desc: Returns the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.

is_config_individual.desc: Returns true if the config can be edited individually for each joint.

is_end_bone_extended.desc: Returns true if the end bone is extended to have a tail.

reset.desc: Resets a simulating state with respect to the current bone pose. It is useful to prevent the simulation result getting violent. For example, calling this immediately after a call to [method AnimationPlayer.play] without a fading, or within the previous [signal SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed] signal if it's condition changes significantly.

set_center_bone.desc: Sets the center bone index of the bone chain.

set_center_bone_name.desc: Sets the center bone name of the bone chain.

set_center_from.desc: Sets what the center originates from in the bone chain. Bone movement is calculated based on the difference in relative distance between center and bone in the previous and next frames. For example, if the parent is used as the center, the bones are considered to have not moved if the moves in the world. In this case, only a change in the bone pose is considered to be a bone movement.

set_center_node.desc: Sets the center node path of the bone chain.

set_collision_count.desc: Sets the number of collisions in the collision list at [param index] in the settings when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is false.

set_collision_path.desc: Sets the node path of the at [param collision] in the bone chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is false.

set_drag.desc: Sets the drag force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the more suppressed the wiggling. The value is scaled by [method set_drag_damping_curve] and cached in each joint setting in the joint list.

set_drag_damping_curve.desc: Sets the drag force damping curve of the bone chain.

set_enable_all_child_collisions.desc: If [param enabled] is true, all child s are colliding and [method set_exclude_collision_path] is enabled as an exclusion list at [param index] in the settings. If [param enabled] is false, you need to manually register all valid collisions with [method set_collision_path].

set_end_bone.desc: Sets the end bone index of the bone chain.

set_end_bone_direction.desc: Sets the end bone tail direction of the bone chain when [method is_end_bone_extended] is true.

set_end_bone_length.desc: Sets the end bone tail length of the bone chain when [method is_end_bone_extended] is true.

set_end_bone_name.desc: Sets the end bone name of the bone chain. Note: End bone must be the root bone or a child of the root bone. If they are the same, the tail must be extended by [method set_extend_end_bone] to jiggle the bone.

set_exclude_collision_count.desc: Sets the number of exclude collisions in the exclude collision list at [param index] in the settings when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is true.

set_exclude_collision_path.desc: Sets the node path of the at [param collision] in the bone chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is true.

set_extend_end_bone.desc: If [param enabled] is true, the end bone is extended to have a tail. The extended tail config is allocated to the last element in the joint list. In other words, if you set [param enabled] to false, the config of the last element in the joint list has no effect in the simulated result.

set_gravity.desc: Sets the gravity amount of the bone chain. This value is not an acceleration, but a constant velocity of movement in [method set_gravity_direction]. If [param gravity] is not 0, the modified pose will not return to the original pose since it is always affected by gravity. The value is scaled by [method set_gravity_damping_curve] and cached in each joint setting in the joint list.

set_gravity_damping_curve.desc: Sets the gravity amount damping curve of the bone chain.

set_gravity_direction.desc: Sets the gravity direction of the bone chain. This value is internally normalized and then multiplied by [method set_gravity]. The value is cached in each joint setting in the joint list.

set_individual_config.desc: If [param enabled] is true, the config can be edited individually for each joint.

set_joint_drag.desc: Sets the drag force at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true.

set_joint_gravity.desc: Sets the gravity amount at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true.

set_joint_gravity_direction.desc: Sets the gravity direction at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true.

set_joint_radius.desc: Sets the joint radius at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true.

set_joint_rotation_axis.desc: Sets the rotation axis at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true. The axes are based on the [method Skeleton3D.get_bone_rest]'s space, if [param axis] is [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_CUSTOM], you can specify any axis. Note: The rotation axis and the forward vector shouldn't be colinear to avoid unintended rotation since does not factor in twisting forces.

set_joint_rotation_axis_vector.desc: Sets the rotation axis vector for the specified joint in the bone chain. This vector is normalized by an internal process and represents the axis around which the bone chain can rotate. If the vector length is 0, it is considered synonymous with [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL].

set_joint_stiffness.desc: Sets the stiffness force at [param joint] in the bone chain's joint list when [method is_config_individual] is true.

set_radius.desc: Sets the joint radius of the bone chain. It is used to move and slide with the in the collision list. The value is scaled by [method set_radius_damping_curve] and cached in each joint setting in the joint list.

set_radius_damping_curve.desc: Sets the joint radius damping curve of the bone chain.

set_root_bone.desc: Sets the root bone index of the bone chain.

set_root_bone_name.desc: Sets the root bone name of the bone chain.

set_rotation_axis.desc: Sets the rotation axis of the bone chain. If set to a specific axis, it acts like a hinge joint. The value is cached in each joint setting in the joint list. The axes are based on the [method Skeleton3D.get_bone_rest]'s space, if [param axis] is [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_CUSTOM], you can specify any axis. Note: The rotation axis vector and the forward vector shouldn't be colinear to avoid unintended rotation since does not factor in twisting forces.

set_rotation_axis_vector.desc: Sets the rotation axis vector of the bone chain. The value is cached in each joint setting in the joint list. This vector is normalized by an internal process and represents the axis around which the bone chain can rotate. If the vector length is 0, it is considered synonymous with [constant SkeletonModifier3D.ROTATION_AXIS_ALL].

set_stiffness.desc: Sets the stiffness force of the bone chain. The greater the value, the faster it recovers to its initial pose. If [param stiffness] is 0, the modified pose will not return to the original pose. The value is scaled by [method set_stiffness_damping_curve] and cached in each joint setting in the joint list.

set_stiffness_damping_curve.desc: Sets the stiffness force damping curve of the bone chain.

get_rect.desc: Returns a representing the Sprite2D's boundary in local coordinates.
