If [param encoding] is empty string, system default encoding is used. - For Windows, see Code Page Identifiers .NET names. - For macOS and Linux/BSD, see libiconv library documentation and iconv --list for a list of supported encodings.

to_pascal_case.desc: Returns the string converted to PascalCase.

to_snake_case.desc: Returns the string converted to snake_case. Note: Numbers followed by a single letter are not separated in the conversion to keep some words (such as "2D") together. "Node2D".to_snake_case() # Returns "node_2d" "2nd place".to_snake_case() # Returns "2_nd_place" "Texture3DAssetFolder".to_snake_case() # Returns "texture_3d_asset_folder" "Node2D".ToSnakeCase(); // Returns "node_2d" "2nd place".ToSnakeCase(); // Returns "2_nd_place" "Texture3DAssetFolder".ToSnakeCase(); // Returns "texture_3d_asset_folder"

to_upper.desc: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.

to_utf8_buffer.desc: Converts the string to a UTF-8 encoded . This method is slightly slower than [method to_ascii_buffer], but supports all UTF-8 characters. For most cases, prefer using this method. This is the inverse of [method PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf8].

to_utf16_buffer.desc: Converts the string to a UTF-16 encoded . This is the inverse of [method PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf16].

to_utf32_buffer.desc: Converts the string to a UTF-32 encoded . This is the inverse of [method PackedByteArray.get_string_from_utf32].

to_wchar_buffer.desc: Converts the string to a wide character (wchar_t, UTF-16 on Windows, UTF-32 on other platforms) encoded . This is the inverse of [method PackedByteArray.get_string_from_wchar].

trim_prefix.desc: Removes the given [param prefix] from the start of the string, or returns the string unchanged.

trim_suffix.desc: Removes the given [param suffix] from the end of the string, or returns the string unchanged.

unicode_at.desc: Returns the character code at position [param at]. See also [method String.chr], [method @GDScript.char], and [method @GDScript.ord].

uri_decode.desc: Decodes the string from its URL-encoded format. This method is meant to properly decode the parameters in a URL when receiving an HTTP request. See also [method uri_encode]. var url = "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot%20Engine%3%docs" print(url.uri_decode()) # Prints "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot Engine:docs" var url = "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot%20Engine%3%docs" GD.Print(url.URIDecode()) // Prints "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot Engine:docs" Note: This method decodes + as space.

uri_encode.desc: Encodes the string to URL-friendly format. This method is meant to properly encode the parameters in a URL when sending an HTTP request. See also [method uri_decode]. var prefix = "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=" var url = prefix + "Godot Engine:docs".uri_encode() print(url) # Prints "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot%20Engine%3%docs" var prefix = "$DOCS_URL/?highlight="; var url = prefix + "Godot Engine:docs".URIEncode(); GD.Print(url); // Prints "$DOCS_URL/?highlight=Godot%20Engine%3%docs"

uri_file_decode.desc: Decodes the file path from its URL-encoded format. Unlike [method uri_decode] this method leaves + as is.

validate_filename.desc: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in [method is_valid_filename] replaced with underscores.

validate_node_name.desc: Returns a copy of the string with all characters that are not allowed in [member Node.name] (. : @ / " %) replaced with underscores.

xml_escape.desc: Returns a copy of the string with special characters escaped using the XML standard. If [param escape_quotes] is true, the single quote (') and double quote (") characters are also escaped.

xml_unescape.desc: Returns a copy of the string with escaped characters replaced by their meanings according to the XML standard.

StyleBox.desc: Abstract base class for defining stylized boxes for UI elements.

_get_minimum_size.desc: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default [method get_minimum_size] only takes content margins into account. This method can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account for both sizes.

draw.desc: Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given . The value can either be the result of [method CanvasItem.get_canvas_item] called on an existing -derived node, or directly from creating a canvas item in the with [method RenderingServer.canvas_item_create].

get_content_margin.desc: Returns the default margin of the specified [enum Side].

get_current_item_drawn.desc: Returns the that handles its [constant CanvasItem.NOTIFICATION_DRAW] or [method CanvasItem._draw] callback at this moment.

get_margin.desc: Returns the content margin offset for the specified [enum Side]. Positive values reduce size inwards, unlike 's margin values.

get_minimum_size.desc: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to.

get_offset.desc: Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value equivalent to Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT), style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP)).

set_content_margin.desc: Sets the default value of the specified [enum Side] to [param offset] pixels.

set_content_margin_all.desc: Sets the default margin to [param offset] pixels for all sides.

test_mask.desc: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.

StyleBoxFlat.desc: A customizable that doesn't use a texture.

get_border_width.desc: Returns the specified [enum Side]'s border width.

get_border_width_min.desc: Returns the smallest border width out of all four borders.

get_expand_margin.desc: Returns the size of the specified [enum Side]'s expand margin.

set_border_width.desc: Sets the specified [enum Side]'s border width to [param width] pixels.

set_border_width_all.desc: Sets the border width to [param width] pixels for all sides.

set_corner_radius.desc: Sets the corner radius to [param radius] pixels for the given [param corner].

set_corner_radius_all.desc: Sets the corner radius to [param radius] pixels for all corners.

set_expand_margin.desc: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

set_expand_margin_all.desc: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

StyleBoxLine.desc: A that displays a single line of a given color and thickness.

get_expand_margin.desc: Returns the expand margin size of the specified [enum Side].

get_texture_margin.desc: Returns the margin size of the specified [enum Side].

set_expand_margin.desc: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

set_expand_margin_all.desc: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

set_texture_margin.desc: Sets the margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

set_texture_margin_all.desc: Sets the margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

set_delay.desc: Sets the time in seconds after which the will start running the subtween. By default there's no delay.

SubViewport.desc: An interface to a game world that doesn't create a window or draw to the screen directly.

SubViewportContainer.desc: A container used for displaying the contents of a .

_propagate_input_event.desc: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. If it returns true, the [param event] is propagated to children. Propagation doesn't happen if it returns false. If the function is not implemented, all events are propagated to SubViewports.

add_index.desc: Adds a vertex to index array if you are using indexed vertices. Does not need to be called before adding vertices.

add_triangle_fan.desc: Inserts a triangle fan made of array data into being constructed. Requires the primitive type be set to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

add_vertex.desc: Specifies the position of current vertex. Should be called after specifying other vertex properties (e.g. Color, UV).

append_from.desc: Append vertices from a given surface onto the current vertex array with specified .

begin.desc: Called before adding any vertices. Takes the primitive type as an argument (e.g. [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES]).

clear.desc: Clear all information passed into the surface tool so far.

commit.desc: Returns a constructed from current information passed in. If an existing is passed in as an argument, will add an extra surface to the existing . The [param flags] argument can be the bitwise OR of [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS], or [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USES_EMPTY_VERTEX_ARRAY].

commit_to_arrays.desc: Commits the data to the same format used by [method ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays], [method ImporterMesh.add_surface], and [method create_from_arrays]. This way you can further process the mesh data using the or APIs.

create_from.desc: Creates a vertex array from an existing .

create_from_arrays.desc: Creates this SurfaceTool from existing vertex arrays such as returned by [method commit_to_arrays], [method Mesh.surface_get_arrays], [method Mesh.surface_get_blend_shape_arrays], [method ImporterMesh.get_surface_arrays], and [method ImporterMesh.get_surface_blend_shape_arrays]. [param primitive_type] controls the type of mesh data, defaulting to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

create_from_blend_shape.desc: Creates a vertex array from the specified blend shape of an existing . This can be used to extract a specific pose from a blend shape.

deindex.desc: Removes the index array by expanding the vertex array.

generate_lod.desc: Generates an LOD for a given [param nd_threshold] in linear units (square root of quadric error metric), using at most [param target_index_count] indices.

generate_normals.desc: Generates normals from vertices so you do not have to do it manually. If [param flip] is true, the resulting normals will be inverted. [method generate_normals] should be called after generating geometry and before committing the mesh using [method commit] or [method commit_to_arrays]. For correct display of normal-mapped surfaces, you will also have to generate tangents using [method generate_tangents]. Note: [method generate_normals] only works if the primitive type is set to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES]. Note: [method generate_normals] takes smooth groups into account. To generate smooth normals, set the smooth group to a value greater than or equal to 0 using [method set_smooth_group] or leave the smooth group at the default of 0. To generate flat normals, set the smooth group to -1 using [method set_smooth_group] prior to adding vertices.

generate_tangents.desc: Generates a tangent vector for each vertex. Requires that each vertex already has UVs and normals set (see [method generate_normals]).

get_aabb.desc: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the vertex positions.

get_custom_format.desc: Returns the format for custom [param channel_index] (currently up to 4). Returns [constant CUSTOM_MAX] if this custom channel is unused.

get_primitive_type.desc: Returns the type of mesh geometry, such as [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

get_skin_weight_count.desc: By default, returns [constant SKIN_4_WEIGHTS] to indicate only 4 bone influences per vertex are used. Returns [constant SKIN_8_WEIGHTS] if up to 8 influences are used. Note: This function returns an enum, not the exact number of weights.

index.desc: Shrinks the vertex array by creating an index array. This can improve performance by avoiding vertex reuse.

optimize_indices_for_cache.desc: Optimizes triangle sorting for performance. Requires that [method get_primitive_type] is [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

set_bones.desc: Specifies an array of bones to use for the next vertex. [param bones] must contain 4 integers.

set_color.desc: Specifies a to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all. Note: The material must have [member BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo] enabled for the vertex color to be visible.

set_custom.desc: Sets the custom value on this vertex for [param channel_index]. [method set_custom_format] must be called first for this [param channel_index]. Formats which are not RGBA will ignore other color channels.

set_custom_format.desc: Sets the color format for this custom [param channel_index]. Use [constant CUSTOM_MAX] to disable. Must be invoked after [method begin] and should be set before [method commit] or [method commit_to_arrays].

set_material.desc: Sets to be used by the you are constructing.

set_normal.desc: Specifies a normal to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_skin_weight_count.desc: Set to [constant SKIN_8_WEIGHTS] to indicate that up to 8 bone influences per vertex may be used. By default, only 4 bone influences are used ([constant SKIN_4_WEIGHTS]). Note: This function takes an enum, not the exact number of weights.

set_smooth_group.desc: Specifies the smooth group to use for the next vertex. If this is never called, all vertices will have the default smooth group of 0 and will be smoothed with adjacent vertices of the same group. To produce a mesh with flat normals, set the smooth group to -1. Note: This function actually takes a uint32_t, so C# users should use uint32.MaxValue instead of -1 to produce a mesh with flat normals.

set_tangent.desc: Specifies a tangent to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all. Note: Even though [param tangent] is a , it does not directly represent the tangent plane. Its [member Plane.x], [member Plane.y], and [member Plane.z] represent the tangent vector and [member Plane.d] should be either -1 or 1. See also [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT].

set_uv.desc: Specifies a set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_uv2.desc: Specifies an optional second set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_weights.desc: Specifies weight values to use for the next vertex. [param weights] must contain 4 values. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

SyntaxHighlighter.desc: Base class for syntax highlighters. Provides syntax highlighting data to a .

_clear_highlighting_cache.desc: Virtual method which can be overridden to clear any local caches.

_get_line_syntax_highlighting.desc: Virtual method which can be overridden to return syntax highlighting data. See [method get_line_syntax_highlighting] for more details.

_update_cache.desc: Virtual method which can be overridden to update any local caches.

clear_highlighting_cache.desc: Clears all cached syntax highlighting data. Then calls overridable method [method _clear_highlighting_cache].

get_line_syntax_highlighting.desc: Returns the syntax highlighting data for the line at index [param line]. If the line is not cached, calls [method _get_line_syntax_highlighting] first to calculate the data. Each entry is a column number containing a nested . The column number denotes the start of a region, the region will end if another region is found, or at the end of the line. The nested contains the data for that region. Currently only the key "color" is supported. Example: Possible return value. This means columns 0 to 4 should be red, and columns 5 to the end of the line should be green: { 0: { "color": Color(1, 0, 0) }, 5: { "color": Color(0, 1, 0) } }

update_cache.desc: Clears then updates the caches. Override [method _update_cache] for a callback. Note: This is called automatically when the associated node, updates its own cache.

SystemFont.desc: A font loaded from a system font. Falls back to a default theme font if not implemented on the host OS.

TabBar.desc: A control that provides a horizontal bar with tabs.

ensure_tab_visible.desc: Moves the scroll view to make the tab visible.

get_offset_buttons_visible.desc: Returns true if the offset buttons (the ones that appear when there's not enough space for all tabs) are visible.

get_previous_tab.desc: Returns the previously active tab index.

get_tab_button_icon.desc: Returns the icon for the right button of the tab at index [param tab_idx] or null if the right button has no icon.

get_tab_icon.desc: Returns the icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx] or null if the tab has no icon.

get_tab_icon_max_width.desc: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx].

get_tab_idx_at_point.desc: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates [param point]. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.

get_tab_metadata.desc: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index [param tab_idx] using [method set_tab_metadata]. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.

get_tab_offset.desc: Returns the number of hidden tabs offsetted to the left.

get_tab_rect.desc: Returns tab with local position and size.

get_tab_text_direction.desc: Returns tab title text base writing direction.

get_tab_title.desc: Returns the title of the tab at index [param tab_idx].

get_tab_tooltip.desc: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index [param tab_idx].

is_tab_disabled.desc: Returns true if the tab at index [param tab_idx] is disabled.

is_tab_hidden.desc: Returns true if the tab at index [param tab_idx] is hidden.

move_tab.desc: Moves a tab from [param from] to [param to].

remove_tab.desc: Removes the tab at index [param tab_idx].

select_next_available.desc: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

select_previous_available.desc: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

set_tab_button_icon.desc: Sets an [param icon] for the button of the tab at index [param tab_idx] (located to the right, before the close button), making it visible and clickable (See [signal tab_button_pressed]). Giving it a null value will hide the button.

set_tab_disabled.desc: If [param disabled] is true, disables the tab at index [param tab_idx], making it non-interactable.

set_tab_hidden.desc: If [param hidden] is true, hides the tab at index [param tab_idx], making it disappear from the tab area.

set_tab_icon.desc: Sets an [param icon] for the tab at index [param tab_idx].

set_tab_icon_max_width.desc: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx]. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of [theme_item icon_max_width]. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.

set_tab_language.desc: Sets the language code of the title for the tab at index [param tab_idx] to [param language]. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If [param language] is empty, the current locale is used.

set_tab_metadata.desc: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index [param tab_idx], which can be retrieved later using [method get_tab_metadata].

set_tab_text_direction.desc: Sets tab title base writing direction.

set_tab_title.desc: Sets a [param title] for the tab at index [param tab_idx].

set_tab_tooltip.desc: Sets a [param tooltip] for tab at index [param tab_idx]. Note: By default, if the [param tooltip] is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all characters fit into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip. To hide the tooltip, assign " " as the [param tooltip] text.

TabContainer.desc: A container that creates a tab for each child control, displaying only the active tab's control.

get_current_tab_control.desc: Returns the child node located at the active tab index.

get_popup.desc: Returns the node instance if one has been set already with [method set_popup]. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their [member Window.visible] property.

get_previous_tab.desc: Returns the previously active tab index.

get_tab_bar.desc: Returns the contained in this container. Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it or editing its tabs may cause a crash. If you wish to edit the tabs, use the methods provided in .

get_tab_button_icon.desc: Returns the button icon from the tab at index [param tab_idx].

get_tab_control.desc: Returns the node from the tab at index [param tab_idx].

get_tab_icon.desc: Returns the for the tab at index [param tab_idx] or null if the tab has no .

get_tab_icon_max_width.desc: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx].

get_tab_idx_at_point.desc: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates [param point]. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.

get_tab_idx_from_control.desc: Returns the index of the tab tied to the given [param control]. The control must be a child of the .

get_tab_metadata.desc: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index [param tab_idx] using [method set_tab_metadata]. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.

get_tab_title.desc: Returns the title of the tab at index [param tab_idx]. Tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node, but this can be overridden with [method set_tab_title].

get_tab_tooltip.desc: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index [param tab_idx].

is_tab_disabled.desc: Returns true if the tab at index [param tab_idx] is disabled.

is_tab_hidden.desc: Returns true if the tab at index [param tab_idx] is hidden.

select_next_available.desc: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

select_previous_available.desc: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

set_popup.desc: If set on a node instance, a popup menu icon appears in the top-right corner of the (setting it to null will make it go away). Clicking it will expand the node.

set_tab_button_icon.desc: Sets the button icon from the tab at index [param tab_idx].

set_tab_disabled.desc: If [param disabled] is true, disables the tab at index [param tab_idx], making it non-interactable.

set_tab_hidden.desc: If [param hidden] is true, hides the tab at index [param tab_idx], making it disappear from the tab area.

set_tab_icon.desc: Sets an icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx].

set_tab_icon_max_width.desc: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index [param tab_idx]. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of [theme_item icon_max_width]. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.

set_tab_metadata.desc: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index [param tab_idx], which can be retrieved later using [method get_tab_metadata].

set_tab_title.desc: Sets a custom title for the tab at index [param tab_idx] (tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node). Set it back to the child's name to make the tab default to it again.

set_tab_tooltip.desc: Sets a custom tooltip text for tab at index [param tab_idx]. Note: By default, if the [param tooltip] is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all characters fit into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip. To hide the tooltip, assign " " as the [param tooltip] text.

get_local_port.desc: Returns the local port this server is listening to.

listen.desc: Listen on the [param port] binding to [param bind_address]. If [param bind_address] is set as "*" (default), the server will listen on all available addresses (both IPv4 and IPv6). If [param bind_address] is set as "0.0.0.0" (for IPv4) or "::" (for IPv6), the server will listen on all available addresses matching that IP type. If [param bind_address] is set to any valid address (e.g. "192.168.1.101", "::1", etc.), the server will only listen on the interface with that address (or fail if no interface with the given address exists).

take_connection.desc: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerTCP with the connection.

_backspace.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the backspace key.

_copy.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.

_cut.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.

_handle_unicode_input.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the provided key [param unicode_char].

_paste.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation.

_paste_primary_clipboard.desc: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation with middle mouse button. Note: This method is only implemented on Linux.

add_caret.desc: Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new caret, or -1 if the location is invalid.

add_caret_at_carets.desc: Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If [param below] is true the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.

add_gutter.desc: Register a new gutter to this . Use [param at] to have a specific gutter order. A value of -1 appends the gutter to the right.

add_selection_for_next_occurrence.desc: Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.

adjust_viewport_to_caret.desc: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.

apply_ime.desc: Applies text from the Input Method Editor (IME) to each caret and closes the IME if it is open.

backspace.desc: Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with [method _backspace].

begin_complex_operation.desc: Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until [method end_complex_operation] is called.

begin_multicaret_edit.desc: Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with [method end_multicaret_edit]. Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret indexes aren't affected immediately. [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit] can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last [method end_multicaret_edit]. begin_complex_operation() begin_multicaret_edit() for i in range(get_caret_count()): if multicaret_edit_ignore_caret(i): continue # Logic here. end_multicaret_edit() end_complex_operation()

cancel_ime.desc: Closes the Input Method Editor (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME will be lost.

center_viewport_to_caret.desc: Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also resets the [member scroll_horizontal] value to 0.

clear.desc: Performs a full reset of , including undo history.

collapse_carets.desc: Collapse all carets in the given range to the [param from_line] and [param from_column] position. [param inclusive] applies to both ends. If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is true, carets that are collapsed will be true for [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret]. [method merge_overlapping_carets] will be called if any carets were collapsed.

copy.desc: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with [method _copy].

cut.desc: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with [method _cut].

end_action.desc: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with [method start_action].

end_complex_operation.desc: Ends a multipart edit, started with [method begin_complex_operation]. If called outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the undo/redo stack.

end_multicaret_edit.desc: Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with [method begin_multicaret_edit]. If this was the last [method end_multicaret_edit] and [method merge_overlapping_carets] was called, carets will be merged.

get_caret_column.desc: Returns the column the editing caret is at.

get_caret_count.desc: Returns the number of carets in this .

get_caret_draw_pos.desc: Returns the caret pixel draw position.

get_caret_index_edit_order.desc: Returns a list of caret indexes in their edit order, this done from bottom to top. Edit order refers to the way actions such as [method insert_text_at_caret] are applied.

get_caret_line.desc: Returns the line the editing caret is on.

get_caret_wrap_index.desc: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.

get_first_non_whitespace_column.desc: Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of characters.

get_gutter_count.desc: Returns the number of gutters registered.

get_gutter_name.desc: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.

get_gutter_type.desc: Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

get_gutter_width.desc: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.

get_indent_level.desc: Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size into account (see [method get_tab_size]).

get_last_full_visible_line.desc: Returns the last visible line. Use [method get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index] for the wrap index.

get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index.desc: Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.

get_last_unhidden_line.desc: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire .

get_line.desc: Returns the text of a specific line.

get_line_background_color.desc: Returns the custom background color of the given line. If no color is set, returns Color(0, 0, 0, 0).

get_line_column_at_pos.desc: Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned vector, x is the column and y is the line. If [param clamp_line] is false and [param position] is below the last line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned. If [param clamp_column] is false and [param position] is outside the column range of the line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned.

get_line_count.desc: Returns the number of lines in the text.

get_line_gutter_icon.desc: Returns the icon currently in [param gutter] at [param line]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_ICON] (see [method set_gutter_type]).

get_line_gutter_item_color.desc: Returns the color currently in [param gutter] at [param line].

get_line_gutter_metadata.desc: Returns the metadata currently in [param gutter] at [param line].

get_line_gutter_text.desc: Returns the text currently in [param gutter] at [param line]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_STRING] (see [method set_gutter_type]).

get_line_height.desc: Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines. Note: The return value is influenced by [theme_item line_spacing] and [theme_item font_size]. And it will not be less than 1.

get_line_ranges_from_carets.desc: Returns an of line ranges where x is the first line and y is the last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even if it has multiple carets on it. If a selection's end column ([method get_selection_to_column]) is at column 0, that line will not be included. If a selection begins on the line after another selection ends and [param merge_adjacent] is true, or they begin and end on the same line, one line range will include both selections.

get_line_width.desc: Returns the width in pixels of the [param wrap_index] on [param line].

get_line_with_ime.desc: Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME composition string.

get_line_wrap_count.desc: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.

get_line_wrap_index_at_column.desc: Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This ranges from 0 to [method get_line_wrap_count].

get_line_wrapped_text.desc: Returns an array of s representing each wrapped index.

get_local_mouse_pos.desc: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.

get_menu.desc: Returns the of this . By default, this menu is displayed when right-clicking on the . You can add custom menu items or remove standard ones. Make sure your IDs don't conflict with the standard ones (see [enum MenuItems]). For example: func _ready(): var menu = get_menu() # Remove all items after "Redo". menu.item_count = menu.get_item_index(MENU_REDO) + 1 # Add custom items. menu.add_separator() menu.add_item("Insert Date", MENU_MAX + 1) # Connect callback. menu.id_pressed.connect(_on_item_pressed) func _on_item_pressed(id): if id == MENU_MAX + 1: insert_text_at_caret(Time.get_date_string_from_system()) public override void _Ready() { var menu = GetMenu(); // Remove all items after "Redo". menu.ItemCount = menu.GetItemIndex(TextEdit.MenuItems.Redo) + 1; // Add custom items. menu.AddSeparator(); menu.AddItem("Insert Date", TextEdit.MenuItems.Max + 1); // Add event handler. menu.IdPressed += OnItemPressed; } public void OnItemPressed(int id) { if (id == TextEdit.MenuItems.Max + 1) { InsertTextAtCaret(Time.GetDateStringFromSystem()); } } Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their [member Window.visible] property.

get_minimap_line_at_pos.desc: Returns the equivalent minimap line at [param position].

get_minimap_visible_lines.desc: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.

get_next_composite_character_column.desc: Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters. Note: To check at caret location use get_next_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())

get_next_visible_line_index_offset_from.desc: Similar to [method get_next_visible_line_offset_from], but takes into account the line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, x is the line, y is the wrap index.

get_next_visible_line_offset_from.desc: Returns the count to the next visible line from [param line] to line + visible_amount. Can also count backwards. For example if a has 5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with line = 1, visible_amount = 1 would return 3.

get_pos_at_line_column.desc: Returns the local position for the given [param line] and [param column]. If x or y of the returned vector equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control. Note: The Y position corresponds to the bottom side of the line. Use [method get_rect_at_line_column] to get the top side position.

get_previous_composite_character_column.desc: Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters. Note: To check at caret location use get_previous_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())

get_rect_at_line_column.desc: Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given [param line] and [param column]. If x or y position of the returned rect equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control. Note: The Y position of the returned rect corresponds to the top side of the line, unlike [method get_pos_at_line_column] which returns the bottom side.

get_saved_version.desc: Returns the last tagged saved version from [method tag_saved_version].

get_scroll_pos_for_line.desc: Returns the scroll position for [param wrap_index] of [param line].

get_selected_text.desc: Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if [param caret_index] is its default value -1.

get_selection_at_line_column.desc: Returns the caret index of the selection at the given [param line] and [param column], or -1 if there is none. If [param include_edges] is false, the position must be inside the selection and not at either end. If [param only_selections] is false, carets without a selection will also be considered.

get_selection_column.desc: Returns the original start column of the selection.

get_selection_from_column.desc: Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

get_selection_from_line.desc: Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

get_selection_line.desc: Returns the original start line of the selection.

get_selection_origin_column.desc: Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

get_selection_origin_line.desc: Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

get_selection_to_column.desc: Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

get_selection_to_line.desc: Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

get_sorted_carets.desc: Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and column to highest (from top to bottom of text). If [param include_ignored_carets] is false, carets from [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret] will be ignored.

get_total_gutter_width.desc: Returns the total width of all gutters and internal padding.

get_total_visible_line_count.desc: Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If [member wrap_mode] is set to [constant LINE_WRAPPING_NONE] and no lines are folded (see [method CodeEdit.is_line_folded]) then this is equivalent to [method get_line_count]. See [method get_visible_line_count_in_range] for a limited range of lines.

get_version.desc: Returns the current version of the . The version is a count of recorded operations by the undo/redo history.

get_visible_line_count.desc: Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based on this control's height.

get_visible_line_count_in_range.desc: Returns the total number of lines between [param from_line] and [param to_line] (inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to [method get_total_visible_line_count].

get_word_under_caret.desc: Returns a text with the word under the caret's location.

has_ime_text.desc: Returns true if the user has text in the Input Method Editor (IME).

has_redo.desc: Returns true if a "redo" action is available.

has_selection.desc: Returns true if the user has selected text.

has_undo.desc: Returns true if an "undo" action is available.

insert_line_at.desc: Inserts a new line with [param text] at [param line].

insert_text.desc: Inserts the [param text] at [param line] and [param column]. If [param before_selection_begin] is true, carets and selections that begin at [param line] and [param column] will moved to the end of the inserted text, along with all carets after it. If [param before_selection_end] is true, selections that end at [param line] and [param column] will be extended to the end of the inserted text. These parameters can be used to insert text inside of or outside of selections.

insert_text_at_caret.desc: Insert the specified text at the caret position.

is_caret_after_selection_origin.desc: Returns true if the caret of the selection is after the selection origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.

is_caret_visible.desc: Returns true if the caret is visible, false otherwise. A caret will be considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is enabled. Note: [method is_caret_visible] does not account for a caret being off-screen if it is still within the scrollable area. It will return true even if the caret is off-screen as long as it meets 's own conditions for being visible. This includes uses of [member scroll_fit_content_width] and [member scroll_fit_content_height] that cause the to expand beyond the viewport's bounds.

is_dragging_cursor.desc: Returns true if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling, selecting, or text dragging.

is_gutter_clickable.desc: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See [method set_gutter_clickable].

is_gutter_drawn.desc: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See [method set_gutter_draw].

is_gutter_overwritable.desc: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].

is_in_mulitcaret_edit.desc: Returns true if a [method begin_multicaret_edit] has been called and [method end_multicaret_edit] has not yet been called.

is_line_gutter_clickable.desc: Returns true if the gutter at the given index on the given line is clickable. See [method set_line_gutter_clickable].

is_line_wrapped.desc: Returns if the given line is wrapped.

is_menu_visible.desc: Returns true if the menu is visible. Use this instead of get_menu().visible to improve performance (so the creation of the menu is avoided). See [method get_menu].

is_mouse_over_selection.desc: Returns true if the mouse is over a selection. If [param edges] is true, the edges are considered part of the selection.

is_overtype_mode_enabled.desc: Returns true if overtype mode is enabled. See [method set_overtype_mode_enabled].

menu_option.desc: Executes a given action as defined in the [enum MenuItems] enum.

merge_gutters.desc: Merge the gutters from [param from_line] into [param to_line]. Only overwritable gutters will be copied. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].

merge_overlapping_carets.desc: Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret with a selection. If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is true, the merge will be queued to happen at the end of the multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit]. Note: This is not called when a caret changes position but after certain actions, so it is possible to get into a state where carets overlap.

multicaret_edit_ignore_caret.desc: Returns true if the given [param caret_index] should be ignored as part of a multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit]. Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were added during the edit. It is recommended to continue within a loop iterating on multiple carets if a caret should be ignored.

paste.desc: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with [method _paste].

remove_caret.desc: Removes the given caret index. Note: This can result in adjustment of all other caret indices.

remove_gutter.desc: Removes the gutter at the given index.

remove_line_at.desc: Removes the line of text at [param line]. Carets on this line will attempt to match their previous visual x position. If [param move_carets_down] is true carets will move to the next line down, otherwise carets will move up.

remove_text.desc: Removes text between the given positions.

search.desc: Perform a search inside the text. Search flags can be specified in the [enum SearchFlags] enum. In the returned vector, x is the column, y is the line. If no results are found, both are equal to -1. var result = search("print", SEARCH_WHOLE_WORDS, 0, 0) if result.x != -1: # Result found. var line_number = result.y var column_number = result.x Vector2I result = Search("print", (uint)TextEdit.SearchFlags.WholeWords, 0, 0); if (result.X != -1) { // Result found. int lineNumber = result.Y; int columnNumber = result.X; }

select.desc: Selects text from [param origin_line] and [param origin_column] to [param caret_line] and [param caret_column] for the given [param caret_index]. This moves the selection origin and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be deselected. If [member selecting_enabled] is false, no selection will occur. Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

select_all.desc: Select all the text. If [member selecting_enabled] is false, no selection will occur.

select_word_under_caret.desc: Selects the word under the caret.

set_caret_column.desc: Moves the caret to the specified [param column] index. If [param adjust_viewport] is true, the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs. Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

set_caret_line.desc: Moves the caret to the specified [param line] index. The caret column will be moved to the same visual position it was at the last time [method set_caret_column] was called, or clamped to the end of the line. If [param adjust_viewport] is true, the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs. If [param can_be_hidden] is true, the specified [param line] can be hidden. If [param wrap_index] is -1, the caret column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than -1, the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_caret_column] was called. Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

set_gutter_clickable.desc: If true, the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand ([constant Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND]) when hovering over the gutter at the given index. See [method is_gutter_clickable] and [method set_line_gutter_clickable].

set_gutter_custom_draw.desc: Set a custom draw callback for the gutter at the given index. [param draw_callback] must take the following arguments: A line index , a gutter index , and an area . This callback only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM] (see [method set_gutter_type]).

set_gutter_draw.desc: If true, the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type ([method set_gutter_type]) determines how it is drawn. See [method is_gutter_drawn].

set_gutter_name.desc: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.

set_gutter_overwritable.desc: If true, the line data of the gutter at the given index can be overridden when using [method merge_gutters]. See [method is_gutter_overwritable].

set_gutter_type.desc: Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

set_gutter_width.desc: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.

set_line.desc: Sets the text for a specific [param line]. Carets on the line will attempt to keep their visual x position.

set_line_as_center_visible.desc: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the center of the viewport.

set_line_as_first_visible.desc: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the top of the viewport.

set_line_as_last_visible.desc: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the bottom of the viewport.

set_line_background_color.desc: Sets the custom background color of the given line. If transparent, this color is applied on top of the default background color (See [theme_item background_color]). If set to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), no additional color is applied.

set_line_gutter_clickable.desc: If [param clickable] is true, makes the [param gutter] on the given [param line] clickable. This is like [method set_gutter_clickable], but for a single line. If [method is_gutter_clickable] is true, this will not have any effect. See [method is_line_gutter_clickable] and [signal gutter_clicked].

set_line_gutter_icon.desc: Sets the icon for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param icon]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_ICON] (see [method set_gutter_type]).

set_line_gutter_item_color.desc: Sets the color for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param color].

set_line_gutter_metadata.desc: Sets the metadata for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param metadata].

set_line_gutter_text.desc: Sets the text for [param gutter] on [param line] to [param text]. This only works when the gutter type is [constant GUTTER_TYPE_STRING] (see [method set_gutter_type]).

set_overtype_mode_enabled.desc: If true, enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing text instead of inserting text. The [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode] action toggles overtype mode. See [method is_overtype_mode_enabled].

set_search_flags.desc: Sets the search [param flags]. This is used with [method set_search_text] to highlight occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the [enum SearchFlags] enum.

set_search_text.desc: Sets the search text. See [method set_search_flags].

set_selection_origin_column.desc: Sets the selection origin column to the [param column] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.

set_selection_origin_line.desc: Sets the selection origin line to the [param line] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect. If [param can_be_hidden] is false, The line will be set to the nearest unhidden line below or above. If [param wrap_index] is -1, the selection origin column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than -1, the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_selection_origin_column] or [method select] was called.

set_tab_size.desc: Sets the tab size for the to use.

set_tooltip_request_func.desc: Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following args: hovered_word: String.

skip_selection_for_next_occurrence.desc: Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence of the word under caret.

start_action.desc: Starts an action, will end the current action if [param action] is different. An action will also end after a call to [method end_action], after [member ProjectSettings.gui/timers/text_edit_idle_detect_sec] is triggered or a new undoable step outside the [method start_action] and [method end_action] calls.

swap_lines.desc: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.

tag_saved_version.desc: Tag the current version as saved.

add_object.desc: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.

add_string.desc: Adds text span and font to draw it.

clear.desc: Clears text line (removes text and inline objects).

draw.desc: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_outline.desc: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

get_inferred_direction.desc: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

get_line_ascent.desc: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

get_line_descent.desc: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

get_line_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

get_line_width.desc: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

get_object_rect.desc: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

get_size.desc: Returns size of the bounding box of the text.

has_object.desc: Returns true if an object with [param key] is embedded in this line.

hit_test.desc: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

resize_object.desc: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

set_bidi_override.desc: Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

tab_align.desc: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.

add_object.desc: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.

add_string.desc: Adds text span and font to draw it.

clear.desc: Clears text paragraph (removes text and inline objects).

draw.desc: Draw all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_dropcap.desc: Draw drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_dropcap_outline.desc: Draw drop cap outline into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_line.desc: Draw single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_line_outline.desc: Draw outline of the single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_outline.desc: Draw outlines of all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

get_dropcap_lines.desc: Returns number of lines used by dropcap.

get_dropcap_rid.desc: Returns drop cap text buffer RID.

get_dropcap_size.desc: Returns drop cap bounding box size.

get_inferred_direction.desc: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

get_line_ascent.desc: Returns the text line ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

get_line_count.desc: Returns number of lines in the paragraph.

get_line_descent.desc: Returns the text line descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

get_line_object_rect.desc: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

get_line_objects.desc: Returns array of inline objects in the line.

get_line_range.desc: Returns character range of the line.

get_line_size.desc: Returns size of the bounding box of the line of text. Returned size is rounded up.

get_line_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

get_line_width.desc: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the line of text.

get_non_wrapped_size.desc: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph, without line breaks.

get_range.desc: Returns the character range of the paragraph.

get_rid.desc: Returns TextServer full string buffer RID.

get_size.desc: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph.

has_object.desc: Returns true if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

hit_test.desc: Returns caret character offset at the specified coordinates. This function always returns a valid position.

resize_object.desc: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

set_bidi_override.desc: Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

set_dropcap.desc: Sets drop cap, overrides previously set drop cap. Drop cap (dropped capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is larger than the rest of the text.

tab_align.desc: Aligns paragraph to the given tab-stops.

TextServer.desc: A server interface for font management and text rendering.

create_font.desc: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.

create_font_linked_variation.desc: Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.

create_shaped_text.desc: Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given [param direction] and [param orientation]. To free the resulting buffer, use [method free_rid] method. Note: Direction is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT] feature (supported by ). Note: Orientation is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT] feature (supported by ).

draw_hex_code_box.desc: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code. Used for replacing missing characters.

font_clear_glyphs.desc: Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry. Note: This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use [method font_remove_texture] to remove them manually.

font_clear_size_cache.desc: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.

font_clear_system_fallback_cache.desc: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.

font_clear_textures.desc: Removes all textures from font cache entry. Note: This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, use [method font_remove_glyph] to remove them manually.

font_draw_glyph.desc: Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. Note: Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by [method shaped_text_get_glyphs] or [method font_get_glyph_index]. Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_draw_glyph_outline.desc: Draws single glyph outline of size [param outline_size] into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. Note: Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by [method shaped_text_get_glyphs] or [method font_get_glyph_index]. Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_get_ascent.desc: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

font_get_baseline_offset.desc: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

font_get_char_from_glyph_index.desc: Returns character code associated with [param glyph_index], or 0 if [param glyph_index] is invalid. See [method font_get_glyph_index].

font_get_descent.desc: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps.desc: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.

font_get_face_count.desc: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_get_face_index.desc: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_get_generate_mipmaps.desc: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

font_get_global_oversampling.desc: This method does nothing and always returns 1.0.

font_get_glyph_advance.desc: Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph). Note: Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.

font_get_glyph_contours.desc: Returns outline contours of the glyph as a with the following contents: points - , containing outline points. x and y are point coordinates. z is the type of the point, using the [enum ContourPointTag] values. contours - , containing indices the end points of each contour. orientation - , contour orientation. If true, clockwise contours must be filled. - Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a line segment. - One [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicates a single conic (quadratic) Bézier arc. - Two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CUBIC] points between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a single cubic Bézier arc. - Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] points indicate two successive conic (quadratic) Bézier arcs with a virtual [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] point at their middle. - Each contour is closed. The last point of a contour uses the first point of a contour as its next point, and vice versa. The first point can be [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point.

font_get_glyph_index.desc: Returns the glyph index of a [param char], optionally modified by the [param variation_selector]. See [method font_get_char_from_glyph_index].

font_get_glyph_list.desc: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.

font_get_glyph_offset.desc: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.

font_get_glyph_texture_idx.desc: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_get_glyph_texture_rid.desc: Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph. Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_get_glyph_texture_size.desc: Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph. Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_get_glyph_uv_rect.desc: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_get_hinting.desc: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_get_keep_rounding_remainders.desc: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

font_get_kerning.desc: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.

font_get_kerning_list.desc: Returns list of the kerning overrides.

font_get_language_support_override.desc: Returns true if support override is enabled for the [param language].

font_get_language_support_overrides.desc: Returns list of language support overrides.

font_get_msdf_pixel_range.desc: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

font_get_msdf_size.desc: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

font_get_opentype_feature_overrides.desc: Returns font OpenType feature set override.

font_get_ot_name_strings.desc: Returns with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).

font_get_oversampling.desc: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_get_scale.desc: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

font_get_script_support_override.desc: Returns true if support override is enabled for the [param script].

font_get_script_support_overrides.desc: Returns list of script support overrides.

font_get_size_cache_info.desc: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs - number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.

font_get_size_cache_list.desc: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is with font size and outline size.

font_get_spacing.desc: Returns the spacing for [param spacing] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

font_get_stretch.desc: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

font_get_subpixel_positioning.desc: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

font_get_supported_chars.desc: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.

font_get_supported_glyphs.desc: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.

font_get_texture_count.desc: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.

font_get_texture_image.desc: Returns font cache texture image data.

font_get_texture_offsets.desc: Returns array containing glyph packing data.

font_get_transform.desc: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.

font_get_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

font_get_underline_thickness.desc: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.

font_get_variation_coordinates.desc: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.

font_get_weight.desc: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

font_has_char.desc: Returns true if a Unicode [param char] is available in the font.

font_is_allow_system_fallback.desc: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

font_is_force_autohinter.desc: Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_is_language_supported.desc: Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639 code).

font_is_modulate_color_glyphs.desc: Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.

font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fie.desc: Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

font_is_script_supported.desc: Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924 code).

font_remove_glyph.desc: Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry. Note: This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use [method font_remove_texture] to remove them manually.

font_remove_kerning.desc: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.

font_remove_size_cache.desc: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.

font_remove_texture.desc: Removes specified texture from the cache entry. Note: This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, remove them manually, using [method font_remove_glyph].

font_render_glyph.desc: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.

font_render_range.desc: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.

font_set_allow_system_fallback.desc: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

font_set_ascent.desc: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

font_set_baseline_offset.desc: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

font_set_data.desc: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

font_set_descent.desc: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps.desc: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).

font_set_embolden.desc: Sets font embolden strength. If [param strength] is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.

font_set_face_index.desc: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_set_fixed_size.desc: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode.desc: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size is greater than zero.

font_set_force_autohinter.desc: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.

font_set_generate_mipmaps.desc: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

font_set_glyph_advance.desc: Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph). Note: Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.

font_set_glyph_offset.desc: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.

font_set_glyph_texture_idx.desc: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_set_glyph_uv_rect.desc: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_set_hinting.desc: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_set_keep_rounding_remainders.desc: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

font_set_kerning.desc: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.

font_set_modulate_color_glyphs.desc: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

font_set_msdf_pixel_range.desc: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

font_set_msdf_size.desc: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_fi.desc: If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes. Note: MSDF font rendering does not render glyphs with overlapping shapes correctly. Overlapping shapes are not valid per the OpenType standard, but are still commonly found in many font files, especially those converted by Google Fonts. To avoid issues with overlapping glyphs, consider downloading the font file directly from the type foundry instead of relying on Google Fonts.

font_set_opentype_feature_overrides.desc: Sets font OpenType feature set override.

font_set_oversampling.desc: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_set_scale.desc: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

font_set_spacing.desc: Sets the spacing for [param spacing] to [param value] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

font_set_stretch.desc: Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%. Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_transform] instead.

font_set_style.desc: Sets the font style flags. Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], [method font_set_embolden], or [method font_set_transform] instead.

font_set_subpixel_positioning.desc: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

font_set_texture_image.desc: Sets font cache texture image data.

font_set_texture_offsets.desc: Sets array containing glyph packing data.

font_set_transform.desc: Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs. For example, to simulate italic typeface by slanting, apply the following transform Transform2D(1.0, slant, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0).

font_set_underline_position.desc: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

font_set_underline_thickness.desc: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.

font_set_variation_coordinates.desc: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.

font_set_weight.desc: Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700. Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_embolden] instead.

font_supported_feature_list.desc: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.

font_supported_variation_list.desc: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.

format_number.desc: Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used in the given [param language]. If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

free_rid.desc: Frees an object created by this .

get_features.desc: Returns text server features, see [enum Feature].

get_hex_code_box_size.desc: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).

get_name.desc: Returns the name of the server interface.

get_support_data.desc: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

get_support_data_filename.desc: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.

get_support_data_info.desc: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.

has.desc: Returns true if [param rid] is valid resource owned by this text server.

has_feature.desc: Returns true if the server supports a feature.

is_confusable.desc: Returns index of the first string in [param dict] which is visually confusable with the [param string], or -1 if none is found. Note: This method doesn't detect invisible characters, for spoof detection use it in combination with [method spoof_check]. Note: Always returns -1 if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.

is_locale_right_to_left.desc: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.

is_locale_using_support_data.desc: Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.

is_valid_identifier.desc: Returns true if [param string] is a valid identifier. If the text server supports the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature, a valid identifier must: - Conform to normalization form C. - Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or "_". - May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions. - Use UAX #31 recommended scripts only (mixed scripts are allowed). If the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature is not supported, a valid identifier must: - Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or "_". - May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.

is_valid_letter.desc: Returns true if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs to the Unicode category "L".

load_support_data.desc: Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries). Note: This function should be called before any other TextServer functions used, otherwise it won't have any effect.

name_to_tag.desc: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.

parse_number.desc: Converts [param number] from the numeral system used in the given [param language] to Western Arabic (0..9). If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

parse_structured_text.desc: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.

percent_sign.desc: Returns the percent sign used in the given [param language]. If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

save_support_data.desc: Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file. Note: This function is used by during project export, to include TextServer database.

shaped_get_run_count.desc: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.

shaped_get_run_direction.desc: Returns the direction of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_font_rid.desc: Returns the font RID of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_font_size.desc: Returns the font size of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_language.desc: Returns the language of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_object.desc: Returns the embedded object of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_range.desc: Returns the source text range of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_text.desc: Returns the source text of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_span_count.desc: Returns number of text spans added using [method shaped_text_add_string] or [method shaped_text_add_object].

shaped_get_span_object.desc: Returns the text span embedded object key.

shaped_get_span_text.desc: Returns the text span source text.

shaped_get_text.desc: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.

shaped_set_span_update_font.desc: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.

shaped_text_add_object.desc: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.

shaped_text_add_string.desc: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.

shaped_text_clear.desc: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).

shaped_text_closest_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character position closest to the [param pos].

shaped_text_draw.desc: Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout).
