If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. [param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

shaped_text_draw_outline.desc: Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. [param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

shaped_text_fit_to_width.desc: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.

shaped_text_get_ascent.desc: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical). Note: Overall ascent can be higher than font ascent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.

shaped_text_get_carets.desc: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset [param position] in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.

shaped_text_get_character_breaks.desc: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis.desc: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.

shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation.desc: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

shaped_text_get_descent.desc: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical). Note: Overall descent can be higher than font descent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.

shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_ra.desc: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.

shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count.desc: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.

shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs.desc: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.

shaped_text_get_glyph_count.desc: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.

shaped_text_get_glyphs.desc: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.

shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds.desc: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.

shaped_text_get_inferred_direction.desc: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

shaped_text_get_line_breaks.desc: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.

shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv.desc: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.

shaped_text_get_object_glyph.desc: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_object_range.desc: Returns the character range of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_object_rect.desc: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_parent.desc: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.

shaped_text_get_preserve_control.desc: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.

shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid.desc: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters. Note: If set to false, nothing is displayed in place of invalid characters.

shaped_text_get_range.desc: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.

shaped_text_get_selection.desc: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.

shaped_text_get_spacing.desc: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

shaped_text_get_trim_pos.desc: Returns the position of the overrun trim.

shaped_text_get_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

shaped_text_get_width.desc: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

shaped_text_get_word_breaks.desc: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use [param grapheme_flags] to set what characters are used for breaking.

shaped_text_has_object.desc: Returns true if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

shaped_text_has_visible_chars.desc: Returns true if text buffer contains any visible characters.

shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme.desc: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or -1 if none is found.

shaped_text_hit_test_position.desc: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

shaped_text_is_ready.desc: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.

shaped_text_next_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character end position closest to the [param pos].

shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos.desc: Returns grapheme end position closest to the [param pos].

shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width.desc: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.

shaped_text_prev_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character start position closest to the [param pos].

shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos.desc: Returns grapheme start position closest to the [param pos].

shaped_text_resize_object.desc: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

shaped_text_set_bidi_override.desc: Overrides BiDi for the structured text. Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis.desc: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.

shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation.desc: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

shaped_text_set_direction.desc: Sets desired text direction. If set to [constant DIRECTION_AUTO], direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale. Note: Direction is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT] feature (supported by ).

shaped_text_set_orientation.desc: Sets desired text orientation. Note: Orientation is ignored if server does not support [constant FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT] feature (supported by ).

shaped_text_set_preserve_control.desc: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.

shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid.desc: If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.

shaped_text_set_spacing.desc: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

shaped_text_shape.desc: Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns true if the string is shaped successfully. Note: It is not necessary to call this function manually, buffer will be shaped automatically as soon as any of its output data is requested.

shaped_text_sort_logical.desc: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.

shaped_text_substr.desc: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the [param shaped] text buffer (including inline objects).

shaped_text_tab_align.desc: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.

spoof_check.desc: Returns true if [param string] is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader. Note: Always returns false if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.

string_get_character_breaks.desc: Returns array of the composite character boundaries. var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface() print(ts.string_get_character_breaks("Test ❤️‍🔥 Test")) # Prints [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

string_get_word_breaks.desc: Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even. When [param chars_per_line] is greater than zero, line break boundaries are returned instead. var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface() # Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engine", and "4". print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4")) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 16, 18, 19] # Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engin", and "e, 4". print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 5)) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 15, 15, 19] # Corresponds to the substrings "The Godot" and "Engine, 4". print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 10)) # Prints [0, 9, 10, 19]

string_to_lower.desc: Returns the string converted to lowercase. Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by ). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

string_to_title.desc: Returns the string converted to Title Case. Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by ). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

string_to_upper.desc: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE. Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by ). Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

strip_diacritics.desc: Strips diacritics from the string. Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

tag_to_name.desc: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.

TextServerDummy.desc: A dummy text server that can't render text or manage fonts.

_cleanup.desc: This method is called before text server is unregistered.

_create_font.desc: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource.

_create_font_linked_variation.desc: Optional, implement if font supports extra spacing or baseline offset. Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data.

_create_shaped_text.desc: Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given [param direction] and [param orientation].

_draw_hex_code_box.desc: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code.

_font_clear_glyphs.desc: Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.

_font_clear_size_cache.desc: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.

_font_clear_system_fallback_cache.desc: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.

_font_clear_textures.desc: Removes all textures from font cache entry.

_font_draw_glyph.desc: Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_font_draw_glyph_outline.desc: Draws single glyph outline of size [param outline_size] into a canvas item at the position, using [param font_rid] at the size [param size]. If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_font_get_ascent.desc: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

_font_get_baseline_offset.desc: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

_font_get_char_from_glyph_index.desc: Returns character code associated with [param glyph_index], or 0 if [param glyph_index] is invalid.

_font_get_descent.desc: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

_font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps.desc: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.

_font_get_face_count.desc: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_get_face_index.desc: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_get_generate_mipmaps.desc: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

_font_get_global_oversampling.desc: Returns the font oversampling factor, shared by all fonts in the TextServer.

_font_get_glyph_advance.desc: Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).

_font_get_glyph_contours.desc: Returns outline contours of the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_index.desc: Returns the glyph index of a [param char], optionally modified by the [param variation_selector].

_font_get_glyph_list.desc: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.

_font_get_glyph_offset.desc: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.

_font_get_glyph_texture_idx.desc: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_texture_rid.desc: Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_texture_size.desc: Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_uv_rect.desc: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_hinting.desc: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_get_keep_rounding_remainders.desc: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

_font_get_kerning.desc: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.

_font_get_kerning_list.desc: Returns list of the kerning overrides.

_font_get_language_support_override.desc: Returns true if support override is enabled for the [param language].

_font_get_language_support_overrides.desc: Returns list of language support overrides.

_font_get_msdf_pixel_range.desc: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

_font_get_msdf_size.desc: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

_font_get_opentype_feature_overrides.desc: Returns font OpenType feature set override.

_font_get_ot_name_strings.desc: Returns with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).

_font_get_oversampling.desc: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_get_scale.desc: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

_font_get_script_support_override.desc: Returns true if support override is enabled for the [param script].

_font_get_script_support_overrides.desc: Returns list of script support overrides.

_font_get_size_cache_info.desc: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs - number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.

_font_get_size_cache_list.desc: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is with font size and outline size.

_font_get_spacing.desc: Returns the spacing for [param spacing] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

_font_get_stretch.desc: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

_font_get_subpixel_positioning.desc: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

_font_get_supported_chars.desc: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.

_font_get_supported_glyphs.desc: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.

_font_get_texture_count.desc: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.

_font_get_texture_image.desc: Returns font cache texture image data.

_font_get_texture_offsets.desc: Returns array containing glyph packing data.

_font_get_transform.desc: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.

_font_get_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_font_get_underline_thickness.desc: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.

_font_get_variation_coordinates.desc: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.

_font_get_weight.desc: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

_font_has_char.desc: Returns true if a Unicode [param char] is available in the font.

_font_is_allow_system_fallback.desc: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

_font_is_force_autohinter.desc: Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.

_font_is_language_supported.desc: Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639 code).

_font_is_modulate_color_glyphs.desc: Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.

_font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fi.desc: Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

_font_is_script_supported.desc: Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924 code).

_font_remove_glyph.desc: Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.

_font_remove_kerning.desc: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.

_font_remove_size_cache.desc: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.

_font_remove_texture.desc: Removes specified texture from the cache entry.

_font_render_glyph.desc: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.

_font_render_range.desc: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.

_font_set_allow_system_fallback.desc: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

_font_set_ascent.desc: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

_font_set_baseline_offset.desc: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

_font_set_data.desc: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

_font_set_data_ptr.desc: Sets pointer to the font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

_font_set_descent.desc: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

_font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps.desc: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled.

_font_set_embolden.desc: Sets font embolden strength. If [param strength] is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.

_font_set_face_index.desc: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_set_fixed_size.desc: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

_font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode.desc: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size is greater than zero.

_font_set_force_autohinter.desc: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.

_font_set_generate_mipmaps.desc: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

_font_set_global_oversampling.desc: Sets oversampling factor, shared by all font in the TextServer.

_font_set_glyph_advance.desc: Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).

_font_set_glyph_offset.desc: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.

_font_set_glyph_texture_idx.desc: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_set_glyph_uv_rect.desc: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_set_hinting.desc: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_set_keep_rounding_remainders.desc: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

_font_set_kerning.desc: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.

_font_set_modulate_color_glyphs.desc: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

_font_set_msdf_pixel_range.desc: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

_font_set_msdf_size.desc: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

_font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_f.desc: If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.

_font_set_opentype_feature_overrides.desc: Sets font OpenType feature set override.

_font_set_oversampling.desc: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See [member Viewport.oversampling]. This value doesn't override the [code skip-lint]oversampling parameter of [code skip-lint]draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_set_scale.desc: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

_font_set_spacing.desc: Sets the spacing for [param spacing] to [param value] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

_font_set_stretch.desc: Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

_font_set_subpixel_positioning.desc: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

_font_set_texture_image.desc: Sets font cache texture image data.

_font_set_texture_offsets.desc: Sets array containing glyph packing data.

_font_set_transform.desc: Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.

_font_set_underline_position.desc: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_font_set_underline_thickness.desc: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.

_font_set_variation_coordinates.desc: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.

_font_set_weight.desc: Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

_font_supported_feature_list.desc: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.

_font_supported_variation_list.desc: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.

_format_number.desc: Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used in the given [param language]. If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

_free_rid.desc: Frees an object created by this .

_get_features.desc: Returns text server features, see [enum TextServer.Feature].

_get_hex_code_box_size.desc: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).

_get_name.desc: Returns the name of the server interface.

_get_support_data.desc: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

_get_support_data_filename.desc: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.

_get_support_data_info.desc: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.

_has.desc: Returns true if [param rid] is valid resource owned by this text server.

_has_feature.desc: Returns true if the server supports a feature.

_is_confusable.desc: Returns index of the first string in [param dict] which is visually confusable with the [param string], or -1 if none is found.

_is_locale_right_to_left.desc: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.

_is_locale_using_support_data.desc: Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.

_is_valid_identifier.desc: Returns true if [param string] is a valid identifier.

_load_support_data.desc: Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

_name_to_tag.desc: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.

_parse_number.desc: Converts [param number] from the numeral system used in the given [param language] to Western Arabic (0..9). If [param language] is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

_parse_structured_text.desc: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.

_percent_sign.desc: Returns percent sign used in the given [param language].

_reference_oversampling_level.desc: Increases the reference count of the specified oversampling level. This method is called by , and should not be used directly.

_save_support_data.desc: Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.

_shaped_get_run_count.desc: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.

_shaped_get_run_direction.desc: Returns the direction of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_font_rid.desc: Returns the font RID of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_font_size.desc: Returns the font size of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_language.desc: Returns the language of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_object.desc: Returns the embedded object of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_range.desc: Returns the source text range of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_text.desc: Returns the source text of the [param index] text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_span_count.desc: Returns number of text spans added using [method _shaped_text_add_string] or [method _shaped_text_add_object].

_shaped_get_span_object.desc: Returns the text span embedded object key.

_shaped_get_span_text.desc: Returns the text span source text.

_shaped_get_text.desc: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.

_shaped_set_span_update_font.desc: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.

_shaped_text_add_object.desc: Adds inline object to the text buffer, [param key] must be unique. In the text, object is represented as [param length] object replacement characters.

_shaped_text_add_string.desc: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.

_shaped_text_clear.desc: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).

_shaped_text_closest_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character position closest to the [param pos].

_shaped_text_draw.desc: Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_shaped_text_draw_outline.desc: Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_shaped_text_fit_to_width.desc: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.

_shaped_text_get_ascent.desc: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

_shaped_text_get_character_breaks.desc: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

_shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis.desc: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.

_shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation.desc: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

_shaped_text_get_descent.desc: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

_shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_r.desc: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.

_shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count.desc: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.

_shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs.desc: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.

_shaped_text_get_glyph_count.desc: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.

_shaped_text_get_glyphs.desc: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.

_shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds.desc: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.

_shaped_text_get_inferred_direction.desc: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

_shaped_text_get_line_breaks.desc: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.

_shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv.desc: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.

_shaped_text_get_object_glyph.desc: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_object_range.desc: Returns the character range of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_object_rect.desc: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_parent.desc: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.

_shaped_text_get_preserve_control.desc: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.

_shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid.desc: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.

_shaped_text_get_range.desc: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.

_shaped_text_get_selection.desc: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.

_shaped_text_get_spacing.desc: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

_shaped_text_get_trim_pos.desc: Returns the position of the overrun trim.

_shaped_text_get_underline_position.desc: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_shaped_text_get_width.desc: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

_shaped_text_get_word_breaks.desc: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use [param grapheme_flags] to set what characters are used for breaking.

_shaped_text_has_object.desc: Returns true if an object with [param key] is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

_shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme.desc: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or -1 if none is found.

_shaped_text_hit_test_position.desc: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

_shaped_text_is_ready.desc: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.

_shaped_text_next_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character end position closest to the [param pos].

_shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos.desc: Returns grapheme end position closest to the [param pos].

_shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width.desc: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.

_shaped_text_prev_character_pos.desc: Returns composite character start position closest to the [param pos].

_shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos.desc: Returns grapheme start position closest to the [param pos].

_shaped_text_resize_object.desc: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

_shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis.desc: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.

_shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation.desc: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

_shaped_text_set_direction.desc: Sets desired text direction. If set to [constant TextServer.DIRECTION_AUTO], direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.

_shaped_text_set_preserve_control.desc: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.

_shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid.desc: If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.

Theme.desc: A resource used for styling/skinning s and s.

add_type.desc: Adds an empty theme type for every valid data type. Note: Empty types are not saved with the theme. This method only exists to perform in-memory changes to the resource. Use available set_* methods to add theme items.

clear.desc: Removes all the theme properties defined on the theme resource.

clear_color.desc: Removes the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_color] to check for existence.

clear_constant.desc: Removes the constant property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_constant] to check for existence.

clear_font.desc: Removes the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_font] to check for existence.

clear_font_size.desc: Removes the font size property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_font_size] to check for existence.

clear_icon.desc: Removes the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_icon] to check for existence.

clear_stylebox.desc: Removes the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence.

clear_theme_item.desc: Removes the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist. Use [method has_theme_item] to check for existence. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

clear_type_variation.desc: Unmarks [param theme_type] as being a variation of another theme type. See [method set_type_variation].

get_color.desc: Returns the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the default color value if the property doesn't exist. Use [method has_color] to check for existence.

get_color_list.desc: Returns a list of names for properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_color_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_color_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_constant.desc: Returns the constant property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns 0 if the property doesn't exist. Use [method has_constant] to check for existence.

get_constant_list.desc: Returns a list of names for constant properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_constant_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_constant_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for constant properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_font.desc: Returns the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the default theme font if the property doesn't exist and the default theme font is set up (see [member default_font]). Use [method has_font] to check for existence of the property and [method has_default_font] to check for existence of the default theme font. Returns the engine fallback font value, if neither exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_font]).

get_font_list.desc: Returns a list of names for properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_font_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_font_size.desc: Returns the font size property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the default theme font size if the property doesn't exist and the default theme font size is set up (see [member default_font_size]). Use [method has_font_size] to check for existence of the property and [method has_default_font_size] to check for existence of the default theme font. Returns the engine fallback font size value, if neither exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_font_size]).

get_font_size_list.desc: Returns a list of names for font size properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_font_size_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_font_size_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for font size properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_font_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_icon.desc: Returns the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the engine fallback icon value if the property doesn't exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_icon]). Use [method has_icon] to check for existence.

get_icon_list.desc: Returns a list of names for icon properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_icon_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_icon_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for icon properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_stylebox.desc: Returns the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the engine fallback stylebox value if the property doesn't exist (see [member ThemeDB.fallback_stylebox]). Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence.

get_stylebox_list.desc: Returns a list of names for properties defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_stylebox_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_stylebox_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types.

get_theme_item.desc: Returns the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type], if it exists. Returns the engine fallback value if the property doesn't exist (see ). Use [method has_theme_item] to check for existence. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

get_theme_item_list.desc: Returns a list of names for properties of [param data_type] defined with [param theme_type]. Use [method get_theme_item_type_list] to get a list of possible theme type names. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

get_theme_item_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for [param data_type] properties. Use [method get_type_list] to get a list of all unique theme types. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

get_type_list.desc: Returns a list of all unique theme type names. Use the appropriate get_*_type_list method to get a list of unique theme types for a single data type.

get_type_variation_base.desc: Returns the name of the base theme type if [param theme_type] is a valid variation type. Returns an empty string otherwise.

get_type_variation_list.desc: Returns a list of all type variations for the given [param base_type].

has_color.desc: Returns true if the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists. Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_color] to define it.

has_constant.desc: Returns true if the constant property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists. Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_constant] to define it.

has_default_base_scale.desc: Returns true if [member default_base_scale] has a valid value. Returns false if it doesn't. The value must be greater than 0.0 to be considered valid.

has_default_font.desc: Returns true if [member default_font] has a valid value. Returns false if it doesn't.

has_default_font_size.desc: Returns true if [member default_font_size] has a valid value. Returns false if it doesn't. The value must be greater than 0 to be considered valid.

has_font.desc: Returns true if the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists, or if the default theme font is set up (see [method has_default_font]). Returns false if neither exist. Use [method set_font] to define the property.

has_font_size.desc: Returns true if the font size property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists, or if the default theme font size is set up (see [method has_default_font_size]). Returns false if neither exist. Use [method set_font_size] to define the property.

has_icon.desc: Returns true if the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists. Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_icon] to define it.

has_stylebox.desc: Returns true if the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists. Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_stylebox] to define it.

has_theme_item.desc: Returns true if the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type] exists. Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use [method set_theme_item] to define it. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

is_type_variation.desc: Returns true if [param theme_type] is marked as a variation of [param base_type].

merge_with.desc: Adds missing and overrides existing definitions with values from the [param other] theme resource. Note: This modifies the current theme. If you want to merge two themes together without modifying either one, create a new empty theme and merge the other two into it one after another.

remove_type.desc: Removes the theme type, gracefully discarding defined theme items. If the type is a variation, this information is also erased. If the type is a base for type variations, those variations lose their base.

rename_color.desc: Renames the property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_color] to check for existence, and [method clear_color] to remove the existing property.

rename_constant.desc: Renames the constant property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_constant] to check for existence, and [method clear_constant] to remove the existing property.

rename_font.desc: Renames the property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_font] to check for existence, and [method clear_font] to remove the existing property.

rename_font_size.desc: Renames the font size property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_font_size] to check for existence, and [method clear_font_size] to remove the existing property.

rename_icon.desc: Renames the icon property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_icon] to check for existence, and [method clear_icon] to remove the existing property.

rename_stylebox.desc: Renames the property defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_stylebox] to check for existence, and [method clear_stylebox] to remove the existing property.

rename_theme_item.desc: Renames the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param old_name] and [param theme_type] to [param name], if it exists. Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use [method has_theme_item] to check for existence, and [method clear_theme_item] to remove the existing property. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

rename_type.desc: Renames the theme type [param old_theme_type] to [param theme_type], if the old type exists and the new one doesn't exist. Note: Renaming a theme type to an empty name or a variation to a type associated with a built-in class removes type variation connections in a way that cannot be undone by reversing the rename alone.

set_color.desc: Creates or changes the value of the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_color] to remove the property.

set_constant.desc: Creates or changes the value of the constant property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_constant] to remove the property.

set_font.desc: Creates or changes the value of the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_font] to remove the property.

set_font_size.desc: Creates or changes the value of the font size property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_font_size] to remove the property.

set_icon.desc: Creates or changes the value of the icon property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_icon] to remove the property.

set_stylebox.desc: Creates or changes the value of the property defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_stylebox] to remove the property.

set_theme_item.desc: Creates or changes the value of the theme property of [param data_type] defined by [param name] and [param theme_type]. Use [method clear_theme_item] to remove the property. Fails if the [param value] type is not accepted by [param data_type]. Note: This method is analogous to calling the corresponding data type specific method, but can be used for more generalized logic.

set_type_variation.desc: Marks [param theme_type] as a variation of [param base_type]. This adds [param theme_type] as a suggested option for [member Control.theme_type_variation] on a that is of the [param base_type] class. Variations can also be nested, i.e. [param base_type] can be another variation. If a chain of variations ends with a [param base_type] matching the class of the , the whole chain is going to be suggested as options. Note: Suggestions only show up if this theme resource is set as the project default theme. See [member ProjectSettings.gui/theme/custom].

ThemeDB.desc: A singleton that provides access to static information about resources used by the engine and by your project.

get_default_theme.desc: Returns a reference to the default engine . This theme resource is responsible for the out-of-the-box look of nodes and cannot be overridden.

get_project_theme.desc: Returns a reference to the custom project . This theme resources allows to override the default engine theme for every control node in the project. To set the project theme, see [member ProjectSettings.gui/theme/custom].

Thread.desc: A unit of execution in a process.

get_id.desc: Returns the current 's ID, uniquely identifying it among all threads. If the has not started running or if [method wait_to_finish] has been called, this returns an empty string.

is_alive.desc: Returns true if this is currently running the provided function. This is useful for determining if [method wait_to_finish] can be called without blocking the calling thread. To check if a is joinable, use [method is_started].

is_main_thread.desc: Returns true if the thread this method was called from is the main thread. Note: This is a static method and isn't associated with a specific object.

is_started.desc: Returns true if this has been started. Once started, this will return true until it is joined using [method wait_to_finish]. For checking if a is still executing its task, use [method is_alive].

set_thread_safety_checks_enabled.desc: Sets whether the thread safety checks the engine normally performs in methods of certain classes (e.g., ) should happen on the current thread. The default, for every thread, is that they are enabled (as if called with [param enabled] being true). Those checks are conservative. That means that they will only succeed in considering a call thread-safe (and therefore allow it to happen) if the engine can guarantee such safety. Because of that, there may be cases where the user may want to disable them ([param enabled] being false) to make certain operations allowed again. By doing so, it becomes the user's responsibility to ensure thread safety (e.g., by using ) for those objects that are otherwise protected by the engine. Note: This is an advanced usage of the engine. You are advised to use it only if you know what you are doing and there is no safer way. Note: This is useful for scripts running on either arbitrary objects or tasks submitted to the . It doesn't apply to code running during group processing, where the checks will be always performed. Note: Even in the case of having disabled the checks in a task, there's no need to re-enable them at the end. The engine will do so.

start.desc: Starts a new that calls [param callable]. If the method takes some arguments, you can pass them using [method Callable.bind]. The [param priority] of the can be changed by passing a value from the [enum Priority] enum. Returns [constant OK] on success, or [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] on failure.

wait_to_finish.desc: Joins the and waits for it to finish. Returns the output of the passed to [method start]. Should either be used when you want to retrieve the value returned from the method called by the or before freeing the instance that contains the . To determine if this can be called without blocking the calling thread, check if [method is_alive] is false.

TileData.desc: Settings for a single tile in a .

add_collision_polygon.desc: Adds a collision polygon to the tile on the given TileSet physics layer.

add_occluder_polygon.desc: Adds an occlusion polygon to the tile on the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

get_collision_polygon_one_way_margin.desc: Returns the one-way margin (for one-way platforms) of the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

get_collision_polygon_points.desc: Returns the points of the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

get_collision_polygons_count.desc: Returns how many polygons the tile has for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

get_constant_angular_velocity.desc: Returns the constant angular velocity applied to objects colliding with this tile.

get_constant_linear_velocity.desc: Returns the constant linear velocity applied to objects colliding with this tile.

get_custom_data.desc: Returns the custom data value for custom data layer named [param layer_name]. To check if a custom data layer exists, use [method has_custom_data].

get_custom_data_by_layer_id.desc: Returns the custom data value for custom data layer with index [param layer_id].

get_navigation_polygon.desc: Returns the navigation polygon of the tile for the TileSet navigation layer with index [param layer_id]. [param flip_h], [param flip_v], and [param transpose] allow transforming the returned polygon.

get_occluder.desc: Returns the occluder polygon of the tile for the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id]. [param flip_h], [param flip_v], and [param transpose] allow transforming the returned polygon.

get_occluder_polygon.desc: Returns the occluder polygon at index [param polygon_index] from the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id]. The [param flip_h], [param flip_v], and [param transpose] parameters can be true to transform the returned polygon.

get_occluder_polygons_count.desc: Returns the number of occluder polygons of the tile in the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

get_terrain_peering_bit.desc: Returns the tile's terrain bit for the given [param peering_bit] direction. To check that a direction is valid, use [method is_valid_terrain_peering_bit].

has_custom_data.desc: Returns whether there exists a custom data layer named [param layer_name].

is_collision_polygon_one_way.desc: Returns whether one-way collisions are enabled for the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

is_valid_terrain_peering_bit.desc: Returns whether the given [param peering_bit] direction is valid for this tile.

remove_collision_polygon.desc: Removes the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

remove_occluder_polygon.desc: Removes the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

set_collision_polygon_one_way.desc: Enables/disables one-way collisions on the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

set_collision_polygon_one_way_margin.desc: Sets the one-way margin (for one-way platforms) of the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

set_collision_polygon_points.desc: Sets the points of the polygon at index [param polygon_index] for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

set_collision_polygons_count.desc: Sets the polygons count for TileSet physics layer with index [param layer_id].

set_constant_angular_velocity.desc: Sets the constant angular velocity. This does not rotate the tile. This angular velocity is applied to objects colliding with this tile.

set_constant_linear_velocity.desc: Sets the constant linear velocity. This does not move the tile. This linear velocity is applied to objects colliding with this tile. This is useful to create conveyor belts.

set_custom_data.desc: Sets the tile's custom data value for the TileSet custom data layer with name [param layer_name].

set_custom_data_by_layer_id.desc: Sets the tile's custom data value for the TileSet custom data layer with index [param layer_id].

set_navigation_polygon.desc: Sets the navigation polygon for the TileSet navigation layer with index [param layer_id].

set_occluder.desc: Sets the occluder for the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

set_occluder_polygon.desc: Sets the occluder for polygon with index [param polygon_index] in the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

set_occluder_polygons_count.desc: Sets the occluder polygon count in the TileSet occlusion layer with index [param layer_id].

set_terrain_peering_bit.desc: Sets the tile's terrain bit for the given [param peering_bit] direction. To check that a direction is valid, use [method is_valid_terrain_peering_bit].

_tile_data_runtime_update.desc: Called with a TileData object about to be used internally by the TileMap, allowing its modification at runtime. This method is only called if [method _use_tile_data_runtime_update] is implemented and returns true for the given tile [param coords] and [param layer]. Warning: The [param tile_data] object's sub-resources are the same as the one in the TileSet. Modifying them might impact the whole TileSet. Instead, make sure to duplicate those resources. Note: If the properties of [param tile_data] object should change over time, use [method notify_runtime_tile_data_update] to notify the TileMap it needs an update.

_use_tile_data_runtime_update.desc: Should return true if the tile at coordinates [param coords] on layer [param layer] requires a runtime update. Warning: Make sure this function only return true when needed. Any tile processed at runtime without a need for it will imply a significant performance penalty. Note: If the result of this function should changed, use [method notify_runtime_tile_data_update] to notify the TileMap it needs an update.

add_layer.desc: Adds a layer at the given position [param to_position] in the array. If [param to_position] is negative, the position is counted from the end, with -1 adding the layer at the end of the array.

clear.desc: Clears all cells.

clear_layer.desc: Clears all cells on the given layer. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

erase_cell.desc: Erases the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

fix_invalid_tiles.desc: Clears cells that do not exist in the tileset.

force_update.desc: Forces the TileMap and the layer [param layer] to update.

get_cell_alternative_tile.desc: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell on layer [param layer] at [param coords]. If [param use_proxies] is false, ignores the 's tile proxies, returning the raw alternative identifier. See [method TileSet.map_tile_proxy]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_cell_atlas_coords.desc: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords]. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1) if the cell does not exist. If [param use_proxies] is false, ignores the 's tile proxies, returning the raw atlas coordinate identifier. See [method TileSet.map_tile_proxy]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_cell_source_id.desc: Returns the tile source ID of the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords]. Returns -1 if the cell does not exist. If [param use_proxies] is false, ignores the 's tile proxies, returning the raw source identifier. See [method TileSet.map_tile_proxy]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_cell_tile_data.desc: Returns the object associated with the given cell, or null if the cell does not exist or is not a . If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one. func get_clicked_tile_power(): var clicked_cell = tile_map.local_to_map(tile_map.get_local_mouse_position()) var data = tile_map.get_cell_tile_data(0, clicked_cell) if data: return data.get_custom_data("power") else: return 0 If [param use_proxies] is false, ignores the 's tile proxies. See [method TileSet.map_tile_proxy].

get_coords_for_body_rid.desc: Returns the coordinates of the tile for given physics body RID. Such RID can be retrieved from [method KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid], when colliding with a tile.

get_layer_for_body_rid.desc: Returns the tilemap layer of the tile for given physics body RID. Such RID can be retrieved from [method KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid], when colliding with a tile.

get_layer_modulate.desc: Returns a TileMap layer's modulate. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_layer_name.desc: Returns a TileMap layer's name. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_layer_navigation_map.desc: Returns the of the navigation map assigned to the specified TileMap layer [param layer]. By default the TileMap uses the default navigation map for the first TileMap layer. For each additional TileMap layer a new navigation map is created for the additional layer. In order to make switch between TileMap layer navigation maps use [method NavigationAgent2D.set_navigation_map] with the navigation map received from [method get_layer_navigation_map]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_layer_y_sort_origin.desc: Returns a TileMap layer's Y sort origin. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_layer_z_index.desc: Returns a TileMap layer's Z-index value. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_layers_count.desc: Returns the number of layers in the TileMap.

get_navigation_map.desc: Returns the of the navigation map assigned to the specified TileMap layer [param layer].

get_neighbor_cell.desc: Returns the neighboring cell to the one at coordinates [param coords], identified by the [param neighbor] direction. This method takes into account the different layouts a TileMap can take.

get_pattern.desc: Creates a new from the given layer and set of cells. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_surrounding_cells.desc: Returns the list of all neighbourings cells to the one at [param coords].

get_used_cells.desc: Returns a array with the positions of all cells containing a tile in the given layer. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinates identifiers is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_used_cells_by_id.desc: Returns a array with the positions of all cells containing a tile in the given layer. Tiles may be filtered according to their source ([param source_id]), their atlas coordinates ([param atlas_coords]) or alternative id ([param alternative_tile]). If a parameter has its value set to the default one, this parameter is not used to filter a cell. Thus, if all parameters have their respective default value, this method returns the same result as [method get_used_cells]. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinates identifiers is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

get_used_rect.desc: Returns a rectangle enclosing the used (non-empty) tiles of the map, including all layers.

is_cell_flipped_h.desc: Returns true if the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords] is flipped horizontally. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

is_cell_flipped_v.desc: Returns true if the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords] is flipped vertically. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

is_cell_transposed.desc: Returns true if the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords] is transposed. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

is_layer_enabled.desc: Returns if a layer is enabled. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

is_layer_navigation_enabled.desc: Returns if a layer's built-in navigation regions generation is enabled.

is_layer_y_sort_enabled.desc: Returns if a layer Y-sorts its tiles. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

local_to_map.desc: Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given [param local_position]. If [param local_position] is in global coordinates, consider using [method Node2D.to_local] before passing it to this method. See also [method map_to_local].

map_pattern.desc: Returns for the given coordinate [param coords_in_pattern] in a the corresponding cell coordinates if the pattern was pasted at the [param position_in_tilemap] coordinates (see [method set_pattern]). This mapping is required as in half-offset tile shapes, the mapping might not work by calculating position_in_tile_map + coords_in_pattern.

map_to_local.desc: Returns the centered position of a cell in the TileMap's local coordinate space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use [method Node2D.to_global]. See also [method local_to_map]. Note: This may not correspond to the visual position of the tile, i.e. it ignores the [member TileData.texture_origin] property of individual tiles.

move_layer.desc: Moves the layer at index [param layer] to the given position [param to_position] in the array.

notify_runtime_tile_data_update.desc: Notifies the TileMap node that calls to [method _use_tile_data_runtime_update] or [method _tile_data_runtime_update] will lead to different results. This will thus trigger a TileMap update. If [param layer] is provided, only notifies changes for the given layer. Providing the [param layer] argument (when applicable) is usually preferred for performance reasons. Warning: Updating the TileMap is computationally expensive and may impact performance. Try to limit the number of calls to this function to avoid unnecessary update. Note: This does not trigger a direct update of the TileMap, the update will be done at the end of the frame as usual (unless you call [method update_internals]).

remove_layer.desc: Removes the layer at index [param layer].

set_cell.desc: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell on layer [param layer] at coordinates [param coords]. Each tile of the is identified using three parts: - The source identifier [param source_id] identifies a identifier. See [method TileSet.set_source_id], - The atlas coordinates identifier [param atlas_coords] identifies a tile coordinates in the atlas (if the source is a ). For it should always be Vector2i(0, 0)), - The alternative tile identifier [param alternative_tile] identifies a tile alternative in the atlas (if the source is a ), and the scene for a . If [param source_id] is set to -1, [param atlas_coords] to Vector2i(-1, -1) or [param alternative_tile] to -1, the cell will be erased. An erased cell gets all its identifiers automatically set to their respective invalid values, namely -1, Vector2i(-1, -1) and -1. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_cells_terrain_connect.desc: Update all the cells in the [param cells] coordinates array so that they use the given [param terrain] for the given [param terrain_set]. If an updated cell has the same terrain as one of its neighboring cells, this function tries to join the two. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions. If [param ignore_empty_terrains] is true, empty terrains will be ignored when trying to find the best fitting tile for the given terrain constraints. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one. Note: To work correctly, this method requires the TileMap's TileSet to have terrains set up with all required terrain combinations. Otherwise, it may produce unexpected results.

set_cells_terrain_path.desc: Update all the cells in the [param path] coordinates array so that they use the given [param terrain] for the given [param terrain_set]. The function will also connect two successive cell in the path with the same terrain. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions. If [param ignore_empty_terrains] is true, empty terrains will be ignored when trying to find the best fitting tile for the given terrain constraints. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one. Note: To work correctly, this method requires the TileMap's TileSet to have terrains set up with all required terrain combinations. Otherwise, it may produce unexpected results.

set_layer_enabled.desc: Enables or disables the layer [param layer]. A disabled layer is not processed at all (no rendering, no physics, etc.). If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_modulate.desc: Sets a layer's color. It will be multiplied by tile's color and TileMap's modulate. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_name.desc: Sets a layer's name. This is mostly useful in the editor. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_navigation_enabled.desc: Enables or disables a layer's built-in navigation regions generation. Disable this if you need to bake navigation regions from a TileMap using a node.

set_layer_navigation_map.desc: Assigns [param map] as a navigation map for the specified TileMap layer [param layer]. By default the TileMap uses the default navigation map for the first TileMap layer. For each additional TileMap layer a new navigation map is created for the additional layer. In order to make switch between TileMap layer navigation maps use [method NavigationAgent2D.set_navigation_map] with the navigation map received from [method get_layer_navigation_map]. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_y_sort_enabled.desc: Enables or disables a layer's Y-sorting. If a layer is Y-sorted, the layer will behave as a CanvasItem node where each of its tile gets Y-sorted. Y-sorted layers should usually be on different Z-index values than not Y-sorted layers, otherwise, each of those layer will be Y-sorted as whole with the Y-sorted one. This is usually an undesired behavior. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_y_sort_origin.desc: Sets a layer's Y-sort origin value. This Y-sort origin value is added to each tile's Y-sort origin value. This allows, for example, to fake a different height level on each layer. This can be useful for top-down view games. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_layer_z_index.desc: Sets a layers Z-index value. This Z-index is added to each tile's Z-index value. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

set_navigation_map.desc: Assigns [param map] as a navigation map for the specified TileMap layer [param layer].

set_pattern.desc: Paste the given at the given [param position] and [param layer] in the tile map. If [param layer] is negative, the layers are accessed from the last one.

update_internals.desc: Triggers a direct update of the TileMap. Usually, calling this function is not needed, as TileMap node updates automatically when one of its properties or cells is modified. However, for performance reasons, those updates are batched and delayed to the end of the frame. Calling this function will force the TileMap to update right away instead. Warning: Updating the TileMap is computationally expensive and may impact performance. Try to limit the number of updates and how many tiles they impact.

_tile_data_runtime_update.desc: Called with a object about to be used internally by the , allowing its modification at runtime. This method is only called if [method _use_tile_data_runtime_update] is implemented and returns true for the given tile [param coords]. Warning: The [param tile_data] object's sub-resources are the same as the one in the TileSet. Modifying them might impact the whole TileSet. Instead, make sure to duplicate those resources. Note: If the properties of [param tile_data] object should change over time, use [method notify_runtime_tile_data_update] to notify the it needs an update.

_update_cells.desc: Called when this 's cells need an internal update. This update may be caused from individual cells being modified or by a change in the [member tile_set] (causing all cells to be queued for an update). The first call to this function is always for initializing all the 's cells. [param coords] contains the coordinates of all modified cells, roughly in the order they were modified. [param forced_cleanup] is true when the 's internals should be fully cleaned up. This is the case when: - The layer is disabled; - The layer is not visible; - [member tile_set] is set to null; - The node is removed from the tree; - The node is freed. Note that any internal update happening while one of these conditions is verified is considered to be a "cleanup". See also [method update_internals]. Warning: Implementing this method may degrade the 's performance.

_use_tile_data_runtime_update.desc: Should return true if the tile at coordinates [param coords] requires a runtime update. Warning: Make sure this function only returns true when needed. Any tile processed at runtime without a need for it will imply a significant performance penalty. Note: If the result of this function should change, use [method notify_runtime_tile_data_update] to notify the it needs an update.

clear.desc: Clears all cells.

erase_cell.desc: Erases the cell at coordinates [param coords].

fix_invalid_tiles.desc: Clears cells containing tiles that do not exist in the [member tile_set].

get_cell_alternative_tile.desc: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell at coordinates [param coords].

get_cell_atlas_coords.desc: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell at coordinates [param coords]. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1) if the cell does not exist.

get_cell_source_id.desc: Returns the tile source ID of the cell at coordinates [param coords]. Returns -1 if the cell does not exist.

get_cell_tile_data.desc: Returns the object associated with the given cell, or null if the cell does not exist or is not a . func get_clicked_tile_power(): var clicked_cell = tile_map_layer.local_to_map(tile_map_layer.get_local_mouse_position()) var data = tile_map_layer.get_cell_tile_data(clicked_cell) if data: return data.get_custom_data("power") else: return 0

get_coords_for_body_rid.desc: Returns the coordinates of the physics quadrant (see [member physics_quadrant_size]) for given physics body . Such an can be retrieved from [method KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid], when colliding with a tile. Note: Higher values of [member physics_quadrant_size] will make this function less precise. To get the exact cell coordinates, you need to set [member physics_quadrant_size] to 1, which disables physics chunking.

get_navigation_map.desc: Returns the of the navigation used by this . By default this returns the default navigation map, unless a custom map was provided using [method set_navigation_map].

get_neighbor_cell.desc: Returns the neighboring cell to the one at coordinates [param coords], identified by the [param neighbor] direction. This method takes into account the different layouts a TileMap can take.

get_pattern.desc: Creates and returns a new from the given array of cells. See also [method set_pattern].

get_surrounding_cells.desc: Returns the list of all neighboring cells to the one at [param coords]. Any neighboring cell is one that is touching edges, so for a square cell 4 cells would be returned, for a hexagon 6 cells are returned.

get_used_cells.desc: Returns a array with the positions of all cells containing a tile. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinate identifier is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1.

get_used_cells_by_id.desc: Returns a array with the positions of all cells containing a tile. Tiles may be filtered according to their source ([param source_id]), their atlas coordinates ([param atlas_coords]), or alternative id ([param alternative_tile]). If a parameter has its value set to the default one, this parameter is not used to filter a cell. Thus, if all parameters have their respective default values, this method returns the same result as [method get_used_cells]. A cell is considered empty if its source identifier equals -1, its atlas coordinate identifier is Vector2(-1, -1) and its alternative identifier is -1.

get_used_rect.desc: Returns a rectangle enclosing the used (non-empty) tiles of the map.

has_body_rid.desc: Returns whether the provided [param body] belongs to one of this 's cells.

is_cell_flipped_h.desc: Returns true if the cell at coordinates [param coords] is flipped horizontally. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

is_cell_flipped_v.desc: Returns true if the cell at coordinates [param coords] is flipped vertically. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

is_cell_transposed.desc: Returns true if the cell at coordinates [param coords] is transposed. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

local_to_map.desc: Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given [param local_position]. If [param local_position] is in global coordinates, consider using [method Node2D.to_local] before passing it to this method. See also [method map_to_local].

map_pattern.desc: Returns for the given coordinates [param coords_in_pattern] in a the corresponding cell coordinates if the pattern was pasted at the [param position_in_tilemap] coordinates (see [method set_pattern]). This mapping is required as in half-offset tile shapes, the mapping might not work by calculating position_in_tile_map + coords_in_pattern.

map_to_local.desc: Returns the centered position of a cell in the 's local coordinate space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use [method Node2D.to_global]. See also [method local_to_map]. Note: This may not correspond to the visual position of the tile, i.e. it ignores the [member TileData.texture_origin] property of individual tiles.

notify_runtime_tile_data_update.desc: Notifies the node that calls to [method _use_tile_data_runtime_update] or [method _tile_data_runtime_update] will lead to different results. This will thus trigger a update. Warning: Updating the is computationally expensive and may impact performance. Try to limit the number of calls to this function to avoid unnecessary update. Note: This does not trigger a direct update of the , the update will be done at the end of the frame as usual (unless you call [method update_internals]).

set_cell.desc: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell at coordinates [param coords]. Each tile of the is identified using three parts: - The source identifier [param source_id] identifies a identifier. See [method TileSet.set_source_id], - The atlas coordinate identifier [param atlas_coords] identifies a tile coordinates in the atlas (if the source is a ). For it should always be Vector2i(0, 0), - The alternative tile identifier [param alternative_tile] identifies a tile alternative in the atlas (if the source is a ), and the scene for a . If [param source_id] is set to -1, [param atlas_coords] to Vector2i(-1, -1), or [param alternative_tile] to -1, the cell will be erased. An erased cell gets all its identifiers automatically set to their respective invalid values, namely -1, Vector2i(-1, -1) and -1.

set_cells_terrain_connect.desc: Update all the cells in the [param cells] coordinates array so that they use the given [param terrain] for the given [param terrain_set]. If an updated cell has the same terrain as one of its neighboring cells, this function tries to join the two. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions. If [param ignore_empty_terrains] is true, empty terrains will be ignored when trying to find the best fitting tile for the given terrain constraints. Note: To work correctly, this method requires the 's TileSet to have terrains set up with all required terrain combinations. Otherwise, it may produce unexpected results.

set_cells_terrain_path.desc: Update all the cells in the [param path] coordinates array so that they use the given [param terrain] for the given [param terrain_set]. The function will also connect two successive cell in the path with the same terrain. This function might update neighboring tiles if needed to create correct terrain transitions. If [param ignore_empty_terrains] is true, empty terrains will be ignored when trying to find the best fitting tile for the given terrain constraints. Note: To work correctly, this method requires the 's TileSet to have terrains set up with all required terrain combinations. Otherwise, it may produce unexpected results.

set_navigation_map.desc: Sets a custom [param map] as a navigation map. If not set, uses the default navigation map instead.

set_pattern.desc: Pastes the at the given [param position] in the tile map. See also [method get_pattern].
